title: SABRE Hyperpolarization of Unmodified Amino Acids in Partially Aqueous Media: L-[1-13C]-Valine as a Model System
summary: Hyperpolarization techniques enhance the sensitivity of nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), enabling detection of low concentration metabolites and dynamic processes. Signal Amplification by Reversible Exchange (SABRE) transfers spin polarization from parahydrogen without permanent chemical modification of the substrate. Here, we demonstrate SABRE-mediated 13C hyperpolarization of unmodified amino acids using L-[1- 13C]-valine as the primary model system and provide preliminary evidence of applicability to glycine. Signal enhancements exceeding 60-fold were observed on a 1.1 T benchtop NMR spectrometer. The dependence of polarization on parahydrogen bubbling time, solvent composition, and substrate-to-catalyst ratio was investigated.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了利用SABRE（可逆交换信号放大）技术对未修饰氨基酸进行13C超极化，以L-[1-13C]-缬氨酸为主要模型系统，并在甘氨酸上提供了初步适用性证据。在1.1 T台式NMR波谱仪上观察到超过60倍的信号增强，同时研究了极化对氢气鼓泡时间、溶剂组成和底物-催化剂比率的依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 超极化技术能显著提高NMR和MRI的灵敏度，而SABRE方法利用仲氢转移自旋极化且无需对底物进行永久化学修饰。本文旨在扩展SABRE技术到氨基酸类未修饰底物，从而实现对低浓度代谢物动态过程的检测。
AI.method: 采用SABRE技术对未修饰的氨基酸（以L-[1-13C]-缬氨酸为主要模型，甘氨酸为初步验证）进行13C超极化，在1.1 T台式NMR波谱仪上系统考察了仲氢鼓泡时间、溶剂组成及底物与催化剂比例对极化效率的影响。
AI.result: 在1.1 T台式NMR上实现了超过60倍的13C信号增强，并初步证明该方法对甘氨酸同样适用，同时明确了各实验参数（鼓泡时间、溶剂组成、底物-催化剂比）对极化效果的影响规律。
AI.conclusion: SABRE技术可成功应用于未修饰氨基酸的13C超极化，为代谢成像和动态NMR研究提供了新的可能性，无需对底物进行共价修饰，简化了样品制备流程。

title: Benchmark measurements of absolute frequencies and collisional line-shape parameters in the CO-Ar system using comb-based FTS
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures in main manuscript. 5 pages of supplemental document with 2 figures and 2 tables
summary: We report absolute frequency measurements of the CO fundamental band, together with high-precision Ar-induced collisional line-shape parameters using comb-based Fourier-transform spectroscopy. High-quality spectra were obtained with a stable mid-IR optical frequency comb source and careful suppression of technical noise. By applying analysis methods that fully exploit the advantages of optical frequency comb spectroscopy, precise frequency calibration and robust multi-line fitting were achieved, resulting line-center fitting errors below 0.00001 cm$^{-1}$ for most transitions. The measured transition frequencies agree with HITRAN within 0.0001 cm$^{-1}$, supporting the reliability of the semi-empirical database. Multi-line fits using a speed-dependent Voigt profile yield collisional parameters for approximately 40 P- and R-branch lines, providing a reliable experimental benchmark for CO-Ar line-shape modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文利用基于光频梳的傅里叶变换光谱技术，对CO基频带的绝对频率及Ar诱导的碰撞线型参数进行了高精度测量，线中心拟合误差低于0.00001 cm⁻¹，与HITRAN数据库一致性良好，并为约40条P支和R支谱线提供了可靠的CO-Ar碰撞线型实验基准。
AI.motivation: CO是重要的分子，其精确的谱线频率和碰撞线型参数对大气遥感、天文观测及分子光谱学建模至关重要。HITRAN等半经验数据库的可靠性需要高精度实验验证，同时CO-Ar碰撞线型参数的精确测量对理解分子间相互作用和建立可靠的光谱模型具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用稳定的中红外光频梳光源结合傅里叶变换光谱技术，通过有效抑制技术噪声获取高质量光谱；利用光频梳光谱学的优势实现精确频率校准和稳健的多线拟合分析；采用速度依赖的Voigt线型对约40条P支和R支谱线进行多线拟合，提取碰撞线型参数。
AI.result: 大多数跃迁的线中心拟合误差低于0.00001 cm⁻¹；测得跃迁频率与HITRAN数据库在0.0001 cm⁻¹范围内一致，验证了半经验数据库的可靠性；通过多线拟合获得了约40条谱线的碰撞参数，建立了CO-Ar线型建模的可靠实验基准。
AI.conclusion: 光频梳傅里叶变换光谱技术能够实现CO基频带超高精度的频率和线型参数测量，实验结果为CO-Ar碰撞线型建模提供了重要参考基准，并验证了HITRAN半经验数据库的可靠性。

title: Compression of virtual spaces in transcorrelated methods via singular value decomposition: application to the G2 set
summary: We introduce a new singular-value-decomposition-based scheme for constructing small virtual spaces out of large basis sets for transcorrelated (TC) calculations, termed SVD-TC. This work builds on the recent finding that the residual basis error in the TC reference energy converges more slowly than that of the correlation energy. Within the new workflow, the post Hartree-Fock TC calculation is performed in a compressed virtual orbital subspace, obtained by projecting the canonical virtual orbitals from a large basis set onto a smaller basis set through singular value decomposition (SVD). This allows us to achieve the high accuracy allowed by the large basis, whilst the bottleneck steps - TC integral calculation and post-HF correlation method such as CCSD(T) - incur the cost of only a small virtual space calculation. The method therefore is highly efficient, whilst avoiding the composite nature of the reference correction method. Using the new scheme, we widen the scope of benchmark-quality TC results into more complex molecules than previously considered: using the G2-1 set of 55 molecules with first- and second-row atoms, we apply SVD-xTC-CCSD(T) to compute atomization energies. We compare our results against the near-exact semistochastic heat-bath configuration interaction (SHCI) reference values and experiment. We find that SVD-xTC-CCSD(T) delivers chemical accuracy already with triple-$ζ$ basis sets. Finally, we use the quadruple-$ζ$ results to analyze the accuracy of pseudopotentials within the TC method, and show that pseudopotential TC workflow provides faster basis-set convergence than all-electron TC. We also present timings for computing the atomization energies on G2-1 set, demonstrating the efficiency of our TC workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于奇异值分解（SVD）的虚拟空间压缩方案（SVD-TC），用于转相关（TC）计算。该方法将大基组下的正则虚拟轨道通过SVD投影到小基组上，从而在保持大基组精度的同时，仅需小虚拟空间的代价即可完成TC积分和post-HF相关计算（如CCSD(T)）。作者在G2-1基准集（55个分子）上应用SVD-xTC-CCSD(T)计算原子化能，结果与SHCI参考值及实验对比，表明三-zeta基组即可达到化学精度。
AI.motivation: 近期研究发现TC参考能量中的残余基组误差比相关能量的收敛更慢，成为计算瓶颈。现有参考校正方法具有复合性，效率受限。因此需要一种新的方案，既能利用大基组的高精度，又避免大虚拟空间带来的高昂计算代价。
AI.method: 提出SVD-TC方案：将大基组的正则虚拟轨道投影到小基组上，通过奇异值分解获得压缩的虚拟轨道子空间。在此压缩子空间中执行TC积分计算和post-HF相关方法（如CCSD(T)），从而以较小的虚拟空间代价获得大基组级别的精度。
AI.result: 在G2-1基准集的55个含第一、二行原子的分子上，SVD-xTC-CCSD(T)在三-zeta基组下即可达到化学精度。四-zeta结果用于分析赝势在TC方法中的准确性，表明赝势TC工作流比全电子TC具有更快的基组收敛。同时给出了G2-1原子化能的计算时间，展示了TC工作流的高效性。
AI.conclusion: SVD-TC方案成功解决了TC计算中参考能量基组误差收敛慢的问题，避免了参考校正方法的复合性，显著拓宽了基准级TC计算可处理的分子范围，并展示了赝势TC的优势。

title: Spin Rotatory Strength as the Equilibrium Observable for Chiral-Induced Spin Selectivity
summary: We identify the spin rotatory strength---a chirality-odd, finite-frequency spin--dipole cross response---as the equilibrium observable for chiral-induced spin selectivity. Time-reversal symmetry forces the static response to vanish, while nonzero SU(2) Wilson-loop flux is an independent necessary condition. Exact diagonalization of a Kane--Mele--Hubbard model ($N{=}4,6,8$) reveals that gapped molecules robustly suppress the response, whereas near-degenerate systems show amplification at small $N$ whose persistence at larger sizes remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出自旋旋转强度（spin rotatory strength）——一种手征性奇、有限频率的自旋-偶极交叉响应——作为手征诱导自旋选择性（CISS）的平衡态可观测量。时间反演对称性迫使静态响应为零，而非零的SU(2) Wilson环通量是一个独立的必要条件。对Kane-Mele-Hubbard模型（N=4,6,8）的精确对角化表明，有能隙的分子能稳健地抑制该响应，而近简并系统在小N时显示放大效应，其在更大尺寸下的持久性仍是开放问题。
AI.motivation: CISS效应（手征诱导自旋选择性）是凝聚态物理和化学中的重要现象，但目前缺乏一个明确的平衡态可观测量来表征它。作者旨在寻找一个时间反演对称性允许的、能够量化手征分子中自旋选择性响应的物理量，并检验其在不同尺寸和能隙结构下的行为。
AI.method: 作者提出自旋旋转强度（spin rotatory strength）作为CISS的平衡态可观测量，该量是手征性奇、有限频率的自旋-偶极交叉响应。研究中利用时间反演对称性分析其静态限制下的消失，并以SU(2) Wilson环通量作为独立必要条件。通过Kane-Mele-Hubbard模型的精确对角化（N=4,6,8）进行数值验证。
AI.result: 精确对角化结果表明：有能隙（gapped）的分子体系会稳健地抑制自旋旋转强度响应；而近简并（near-degenerate）系统在小尺寸N时表现出放大效应，但该放大效应能否在更大尺寸下持续存在，目前仍是一个未解决的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 自旋旋转强度为CISS提供了一个可计算的平衡态量。研究揭示体系的能隙结构对响应有决定性影响：有能隙体系抑制响应，近简并体系在有限尺寸下放大响应。然而，近简并系统的放大效应在大尺寸下的持久性尚待进一步研究，这为后续工作指明了方向。

title: Analysis of degradation in perovskite solar cells through physics-based machine learning
summary: Degradation in lead halide perovskite solar cells is analysed by inverse modelling of published measurements of characteristics of a single solar cell at ages 0, 90, 280, 480 minutes. We employ machine learning to deduce distributions of material parameter values and hence the physics linked to measured changes. Bayesian parameter estimation is coupled with drift diffusion simulations using the IonMonger code combined with an optical model. We accurately replicated measured changes in device performance with age through variations in model input parameters. Our key result is that degradation is influenced by correlated changes in the concentrations and diffusion coefficients of mobile ions and by interface recombination at large mobile ion concentrations. This study demonstrates the power of machine learning combined with simulations to reliably interpret experimental results, a task which is problematic if using simulation models with only manual exploration of the input parameter space.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机器学习结合漂移扩散模拟（IonMonger代码+光学模型），对铅卤钙钛矿太阳能电池在0、90、280、480分钟四个老化时间点的测量特性进行逆建模分析，成功复现了器件性能随老化时间的变化，发现降解主要由移动离子的浓度和扩散系数的相关变化以及高离子浓度下界面复合所驱动。
AI.motivation: 传统上，理解钙钛矿太阳能电池降解机制依赖手动探索模拟参数空间，这种方式难以可靠地解释实验数据，无法有效揭示降解背后的物理机制。
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯参数估计与IonMonger漂移扩散模拟代码以及光学模型相结合，通过机器学习从不同老化时间（0、90、280、480分钟）的单一太阳能电池测量特性中反演推导材料参数值的分布。
AI.result: 准确复现了器件性能随老化时间变化的测量结果，关键发现是降解受到移动离子浓度和扩散系数的相关变化，以及大移动离子浓度下界面复合的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了机器学习结合模拟能够可靠地解释实验结果，相较于仅依赖手动探索输入参数空间的模拟模型，这种方法在复杂降解机制分析中具有显著优势。

title: Quadrupolar phase transition in superconducting lanthanum hydride
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures in the main text, 7 figures in extended data
summary: Lanthanum hydride (LaH$_{10}$) has been widely studied for its high superconducting critical temperature of 250 K at about 170 GPa pressure. Although the structural ${R\bar{3}m}$-to-${Fm\bar{3}m}$ transition under pressure connected to the emergence of the superconducting phase in this material is broadly understood, the detailed characterization of its nature and its order parameter are still missing. By applying the cluster multipole moment analysis to the hydrogen sublattice, we reveal that this transition is triggered by a quadrupolar $T_{2g}$ order parameter, and we provide evidence for its weak first-order nature. By performing path integral molecular dynamics coupled to a message-passing atomic cluster expansion (MACE) neural network potential, trained on Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) density functional theory configurations, we show that the collapse of the order parameter at the transition is simultaneously associated with the discontinuous softening of the optical $T_{2g}$ phonons. Their symmetry lets them carry a non-negligible electron-phonon coupling in LaH$_{10}$, while the weak first-order nature of the transition makes them soft. The presence of structural instabilities with low-frequency quadrupolar distortions can be a key ingredient to enhance superconductivity in superhydrides and provides guidance for the discovery of new high-$T_c$ superconductors in hydrogen-rich compounds.

AI.tldr: 本文通过簇多极矩分析揭示了LaH₁₀中R3̄m到Fm3̄m结构相变由四极T₂g序参量驱动，并利用路径积分分子动力学结合MACE神经网络势证明该相变为弱一级相变，伴随光学T₂g声子的不连续软化，这种低频四极畸变的结构不稳定性可能是增强超氢化物超导性的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 虽然LaH₁₀在170 GPa压力下具有250 K的超导临界温度，且R3̄m到Fm3̄m结构转变与超导相的出现之间的联系已被广泛理解，但该相变的具体性质及其序参量尚未被详细表征，作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 对氢子晶格应用簇多极矩分析来识别序参量；2) 使用路径积分分子动力学耦合消息传递原子簇展开（MACE）神经网络势，该势基于PBE密度泛函理论构型训练；3) 分析相变过程中的声子行为和电子-声子耦合。
AI.result: 揭示了该相变由四极T₂g序参量触发，具有弱一级相变的特征。相变时序参量的坍缩与光学T₂g声子的不连续软化同时发生，这些声子的对称性使其在LaH₁₀中承载不可忽略的电子-声子耦合，而弱一级相变使它们变得柔软。
AI.conclusion: 具有低频四极畸变的结构不稳定性可能是增强超氢化物超导性的关键成分，为在富氢化合物中发现新的高温超导体提供了指导方向。

title: Equilibrium Distributions for Strongly Nonlinear Many-Body Systems
summary: Obtaining equilibrium distributions of nonlinear systems is essential for accurately computing macroscopic observables. Conventional theoretical corrections are typically limited to weak nonlinearities, where interaction terms can be treated as effectively uncorrelated perturbations and the random phase approximation applies. In this Letter, we develop a framework to determine equilibrium distributions based on the generalized energy equipartition principle. Our approach recovers existing corrections in the weakly nonlinear regime and, crucially, remains valid for strong nonlinearities, where perturbative contributions become correlated and conventional approaches break down. Numerical simulations of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation, the Majda-McLaughlin-Tabak model, and the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou model demonstrate accurate corrections for nonlinearities more than an order of magnitude stronger than those accessible to conventional theories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于广义能量均分原理的框架，用于确定非线性系统的平衡分布。该框架在弱非线性区域能恢复现有修正，并且在强非线性（摄动贡献相关、传统方法失效）条件下依然有效。通过对非线性薛定谔方程、Majda-McLaughlin-Tabak模型和Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou模型的数值模拟，证明了该框架在比传统理论可处理的非线性强度高一个数量级以上的情形下仍能给出准确修正。
AI.motivation: 传统理论修正仅适用于弱非线性情形，其假设相互作用项可作为不相关的摄动处理（随机相位近似成立）。当非线性增强时，摄动项之间产生关联，传统方法失效，因此需要一种能跨越弱到强非线性范围的通用框架来获取平衡分布。
AI.method: 基于广义能量均分原理构建框架来推导平衡分布。该框架在弱非线性极限下可还原现有的理论修正，同时通过处理摄动项之间的相关性，使其在强非线性区域依然成立。
AI.result: 在非线性薛定谔方程、Majda-McLaughlin-Tabak模型及Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou模型的数值模拟中，该方法在非线性强度比传统理论可处理范围高出一个数量级以上的情况下，仍能给出准确的修正结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架显著扩展了非线性系统平衡分布计算的有效范围，从弱非线性延伸到强非线性，为准确计算宏观可观测量提供了更可靠的理论工具。

title: Complete kinematic null for local kinetic dissipation in a sixfold-driven electron fluid
comment: 13 pages total; 3 main-text figures; Supplemental Material included in the same PDF
summary: We identify a complete kinematic null in a two-dimensional electron fluid driven by a sixfold boundary pattern. In the $U_3^\pm$ channel of $D_{12}$, device symmetry excludes both the vector representation $R_1$ and the full first-gradient tensor $R_1\otimes R_1$. Hence at the symmetry-fixed center $\mathbf{j}(0)=0$ and $\partial_i j_j(0)=0$, so every local quadratic dissipative form built from the modeled charge/momentum field through first gradient order vanishes independently of the constitutive coefficients. In an $O(2)$-isotropic angular-harmonic kinetic model the first allowed local sector is $m=3$. For $νq^2/γ_3\ll1$, its heating is set by the previously derived coefficient $κ_4=v_F^4/(16γ_2^2γ_3)$. An explicit incompressible Stokes disk realizes a nonzero center signal, and a finite-moment kinetic boundary-value solution approaches the corresponding local benchmark. Within the local, fixed-current momentum-conserving Stokes regime, the normalized magnetic response can then be fitted for effective $γ_3$ and $γ_2$. Thus the sixfold drive creates a measurement point where ordinary local charge/momentum hydrodynamic dissipation is absent while a kinetic mode remains finite.

AI.tldr: 本文在二维电子流体中发现了一个完整的运动学零点：由六重边界模式驱动的系统中，D12对称性排除了矢量表示和完整一阶梯度张量，使得对称固定点处的所有局域二次耗散形式（至一阶梯度）均严格为零。但O(2)各向同性角谐波动力学模型中首允许局域扇区为m=3，加热由系数κ4决定。非压缩Stokes盘实现非零中心信号，有限矩动力学边值解逼近局域基准，从而可拟合有效γ3和γ2参数。
AI.motivation: 探索二维电子流体中局域流体动力学耗散的对称性限制，寻找一个可以区分局域流体动力学耗散与动力学（非局域）模态的实验观测点。六重边界驱动提供了一个独特的几何配置，使普通的电荷/动量局域耗散被完全抑制，从而暴露出更高阶或动力学的物理机制。
AI.method: 1. 利用D12群的表示论分析六重边界模式的对称性，证明U3±通道中矢量表示R1和全一阶梯度张量R1⊗R1被排除。2. 采用O(2)各向同性角谐波动力学模型，确定首个允许局域扇区为m=3。3. 构造非压缩Stokes盘显式解，验证中心非零信号。4. 求解有限矩动力学边值问题并逼近局域基准解，用于拟合有效γ3和γ2系数。
AI.result: 六重驱动在对称固定点处完全消除局域电荷/动量耗散（至一阶梯度），但动力学模态（m=3扇区）仍然保持有限，其加热由κ4控制。Stokes盘实现非零中心信号，有限矩解逼近局域基准，可实现对γ3和γ2的有效参数拟合。
AI.conclusion: 六重边界驱动创建了一个独特的测量点：在该点，普通的局域电荷/动量流体动力学耗散完全消失，而动力学模态仍然可测量。这为区分局域与非局域耗散机制提供了一种干净的实验方案，并可提取有效的动力学参数γ3和γ2。

title: Numerical modeling of microstructure evolution in nanocrystalline alloys - grain boundary segregation, solute drag and mechanics
summary: Nanocrystalline (NC) alloys hold much promise as structural alloys due to their superior mechanical properties over traditional coarser grained microcrystalline alloys. Strength of metallic alloys is related to the underlying grain size - as represented by the classical Hall-Petch relation. Generally, a metals strength increases with decreasing mean grain size from the micrometer scale to the nanometer scale, until about a mean size of 20 nm. Any further decrease of grain size results in decreasing strength. Thus, there is an optimal range of mean grain size for most metals about which maximum material strength can be obtained. In the context of NC alloys, stabilization of the grain size in this optimal range is one of the primary synthesis challenges. Since nm-scale mean grain sizes are desired, phenomena like GB solute segregation and solute precipitation are utilized during alloy synthesis to mitigate grain growth. Numerical modeling the phenomena of GB-solute interactions and the evolution of these stabilized GBs under mechanical load are of immense interest to the NC alloy community. To enrich the numerical modeling formulations available in this space, we present here a phase-field method based numerical framework to model GB segregation, solute precipitation and effect of external loading on NC alloys. While some of these effects have been modeled in isolation, a unified treatment of the solute and GB segregation with mechanics interactions has not be considered in the literature. We present a 3D FEM finite-strain phase-field formulation for modeling grain evolution and microstructure stabilization. Beyond the formulation, various case studies demonstrate the applicability of this framework. Further, thermodynamic and kinetic arguments are provided based on the evolution of GB energy to explain the effects of solute drag, GB pinning and mechanical deformation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于相场法的三维有限元大变形数值框架，统一模拟纳米晶合金中的晶界溶质偏聚、溶质析出以及外部载荷对合金微结构的影响，并通过多个案例研究验证了该框架的适用性。
AI.motivation: 纳米晶合金因其优异的力学性能而备受关注，但晶粒尺寸的稳定性是合成中的关键挑战。晶界溶质偏聚和溶质析出可用于抑制晶粒长大，然而现有文献中缺乏将溶质、晶界偏聚与力学相互作用统一处理的数值模型，因此需要一个综合的建模框架。
AI.method: 提出一个3D FEM有限应变相场公式，用于模拟晶粒演化和微结构稳定化。该框架统一处理晶界溶质偏聚、溶质析出以及外部力学载荷的耦合效应。
AI.result: 通过多个案例研究展示了该框架的适用性，并基于晶界能演化提供了热力学和动力学论证，解释了溶质拖曳、晶界钉扎和力学变形的效应。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为纳米晶合金领域提供了统一处理溶质-晶界-力学相互作用的数值建模工具，弥补了以往各效应孤立建模的不足。

title: Orbital-selective oxygen holes in cuprate ladders beyond the Zhang-Rice paradigm
summary: The electronic structure of the spin-ladder cuprate Sr14Cu24O41 challenges the presumed universality of the Zhang-Rice singlet (ZRS) framework and models based exclusively on Cu-O hybridized orbitals. Combining polarization-dependent resonant soft X-ray scattering at the O K-edge with inelastic neutron scattering, we show that doped holes in the Cu2O3 ladders localize predominantly in planar non-bonding O 2pz (pπ) orbitals of rung oxygen sites rather than forming conventional ZRS states. Polarization-resolved RSXS uniquely identifies this orbital assignment, while lattice and magnetic excitations reveal its coupled consequences, establishing a unified microscopic picture that excludes the conventional σ-bonded singlet. This oxygen-sublattice charge order produces an anomalous diagonal stretching phonon and explains the absence of incommensurate magnetic fluctuations and anomalous magnon splitting. These findings motivate a reassessment of hole pairing in ladder cuprates and the sufficiency of copper-centric models for cuprate superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过偏振依赖的共振软X射线散射（RSXS）和非弹性中子散射研究自旋梯铜氧化物Sr14Cu24O41，发现掺杂空穴主要局域在梯子rung氧位的平面非成键O 2pz（pπ）轨道中，而非形成传统的Zhang-Rice单重态（ZRS），从而挑战了铜氧化物中铜-氧杂化轨道模型的普适性。
AI.motivation: 自旋梯铜氧化物Sr14Cu24O41的电子结构挑战了Zhang-Rice单重态框架的普适性以及仅基于Cu-O杂化轨道的模型的充分性，因此需要重新审视该体系中掺杂空穴的真实轨道归属。
AI.method: 结合偏振依赖的O K边共振软X射线散射（RSXS）与非弹性中子散射（INS）两种互补探测手段。RSXS通过偏振分辨唯一定位空穴的轨道占据，INS则表征晶格与磁激发，以揭示该轨道归属带来的耦合物理后果。
AI.result: 掺杂空穴主要在rung氧位的平面非成键O 2pz（pπ）轨道中局域化，形成氧亚晶格电荷序。这种电荷序导致异常的对角拉伸声子，并解释了缺失的非公度磁涨落和异常的磁振子劈裂现象，排除了常规σ键合单重态。
AI.conclusion: 该发现建立了一个统一的微观图像，排除了常规σ键合单重态，促使重新评估梯子铜氧化物中的空穴配对机制以及铜中心模型对铜氧化物超导体的充分性。

title: Exact Expressions of Entropy for Classical Non-interacting Many-body Systems
summary: In the thermodynamic limit, the equilibrium state of a many-body system can be characterized by three pairs of conjugate thermodynamic variables: $E/T,V/P,N/μ$. In this limit, the thermodynamic properties in all ensembles are equivalent up to the leading order of $E,V,N$. However, for systems of finite size, this ensemble equivalence is no longer exact, and the thermodynamic properties may differ substantially among ensembles. To quantify these finite-size effects rigorously, it is desirable to develop a universal ensemble theory applicable to systems of arbitrary size, providing exact expressions for entropy and, thereby, giving rise to the precise value of all equilibrium thermodynamic quantities. In this work, we propose a theory that determines the exact entropy expressions for classical non-interacting many-body systems of arbitrary size across all statistical ensembles, based on only two postulates: \textbf{stationarity}, requiring that the physical laws be invariant under time translation, and \textbf{unbiasedness}, requiring that the equilibrium mixed state maximize the entropy subject to the prescribed constraints. Moreover, we show that the entropy expressions obtained in different ensembles converge to the common asymptotic form $S \asymp \ln\!\left( \left( \frac{4πm e E}{3N} \right)^{3N/2} \cdot \left(\frac{V}{N}\right)^N \right)+N$, consistent with the predictions of the large deviation theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于任意尺寸经典无相互作用多体系统的普适系综理论，基于平稳性和无偏性两个公设，推导出所有统计系综中精确的熵表达式，并证明不同系综的熵在大系统极限下收敛到与大规模偏差理论一致的新近形式。
AI.motivation: 在热力学极限下，不同系综的热力学性质等价；但对于有限尺寸系统，系综等价性不再精确，热力学性质可能在各系综间显著不同。为了严格量化这类有限尺寸效应，需要发展一种适用于任意尺寸系统的普适系综理论。
AI.method: 基于两个公设建立理论：(1) 平稳性——物理定律在时间平移下不变；(2) 无偏性——平衡混合态在给定约束下最大化熵。由此推导出任意尺寸经典无相互作用多体系统在所有统计系综中的精确熵表达式。
AI.result: 获得了各系综中精确的熵表达式，并证明不同系综的熵在新近极限下收敛到共同的渐近形式：S ≍ ln(((4πmeE/3N)^(3N/2))·(V/N)^N) + N，与大规模偏差理论的预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 该系统理论为任意尺寸的多体系统提供了精确的熵描述，弥补了有限尺寸系统中系综不等价的不足，并验证了在热力学极限下与既有理论的兼容性。

title: Some features of high-temperature superconductivity on flat bands
summary: In this letter, we examine how the presence of flat band leads to the formation of a high-temperature superconductor even in the case of repulsive pairing interactions. We also show that in the case of flat bands, the high-temperature superconducting state deforms the flat band, tilting it and making the effective mass finite. As a result, neither the superfluid weight nor the supercurrent disappear. Our results are in good agreement with experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了平带（flat band）系统中斥性配对相互作用如何导致高温超导的形成，并发现高温超导态会使平带发生形变（倾斜），从而赋予其有限的有效质量，确保超流权重和超电流不会消失，结果与实验数据高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 探究平带存在时即使配对相互作用为斥性也能形成高温超导的物理机制，并解决平带系统超流权重消失的潜在问题。
AI.method: 通过理论分析考察平带系统中斥性配对相互作用下的超导形成条件，并分析超导态对平带结构的反馈效应（平带倾斜与有效质量的变化）。
AI.result: 发现高温超导态会使平带发生倾斜形变，赋予其有限有效质量，因此超流权重和超电流不会消失；理论结果与实验数据吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 平带系统中斥性相互作用可以驱动高温超导，且超导态对平带的形变效应保证了超电流的可持续性，这为理解平带高温超导提供了新的理论视角。

title: Anomalous current fluctuations in the stochastic XNOR hopping model
summary: We consider fluctuations of the spin current in the stochastic XNOR process, a kinetically constrained hopping model in one spatial dimension. We formulate three conjectures with explicit amplitudes for the long-time current distributions: a Gaussian limit on the $t^{1/4}$ scale for homogeneous initial states with nonzero magnetization, a half-normal limit on the $t^{1/4}$ scale for domain-wall states with opposite magnetizations, and an M-Wright limit on the $t^{1/8}$ scale for homogeneous initial states at zero magnetization. Earlier work identified the tracer mechanism and anticipated the scaling exponents and limiting shapes in the domain-wall and zero-magnetization settings. Starting from the microscopic XNOR dynamics, we predict the missing amplitudes for the continuous-time process and extend the picture to homogeneous biased initial data. Simulations provide numerical support for all three conjectures without fitted parameters. A separate mathematical companion paper presents an extensively AI-generated candidate proof. Generative-AI tools were used in the research and writing workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了随机XNOR过程中自旋电流的涨落，提出三个关于长时间电流分布的猜想：非零磁化均匀初态下的高斯极限（t^{1/4}尺度）、相反磁化畴壁态下的半正态极限（t^{1/4}尺度）、以及零磁化均匀初态下的M-Wright极限（t^{1/8}尺度），并通过无拟合参数的数值模拟提供了支持。
AI.motivation: 此前研究已识别出示踪粒子（tracer）机制，并预测了畴壁态和零磁化情境下的标度指数与极限形状，但缺失具体振幅。本文旨在从微观XNOR动力学出发预测连续时间过程中的缺失振幅，并将理论图景扩展到均匀偏置初始数据。
AI.method: 从微观随机XNOR过程的动力学出发，理论推导电流长时间分布的显式振幅；针对三种不同初始条件（非零磁化均匀初态、相反磁化畴壁态、零磁化均匀初态）分别提出极限分布猜想；通过无拟合参数的数值模拟验证三个猜想。
AI.result: 提出了三个显式振幅的猜想：非零磁化均匀初态的电流涨落在t^{1/4}尺度上服从高斯分布；相反磁化畴壁态的电流涨落在该尺度上服从半正态分布；零磁化均匀初态的电流涨落在t^{1/8}尺度上服从M-Wright分布。数值模拟无拟合参数地支持了所有三个猜想。另有一篇伴生数学论文提供了大量AI生成的候选证明。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了随机XNOR过程中电流涨落振幅的理论空白，将此前已知的标度指数与极限形状图景扩展至完整分布，并通过数值验证确立了这三个极限猜想的可信度。研究过程使用了生成式AI工具。

title: Nanoscale imaging of ferromagnetic vortex dynamics with scanning NV magnetometry
summary: The generation and manipulation of spin waves at the nanoscale via magnetic vortices are of considerable importance because of their broad applications across magnonic and quantum technologies. Previously, fixed nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond have been used to locally characterize vortex dynamics, and scanning NV magnetometry (SNVM) has been used to image vortices' static stray fields. Here, we demonstrate SNVM imaging of both the static and microwave fields generated by vortices in mesoscopic permalloy structures with $\sim$50 nm spatial resolution, achieving excellent agreement with micromagnetic simulations, while revealing the effects of disorder. We further demonstrate a 40$\times$ microwave field enhancement near a vortex core and image the disorder-dependent, spatially varying, evanescent decay of these microwaves. Our ambient, tabletop technique surpasses diffraction-limited techniques' resolutions by at least 5$\times$, with far greater accessibility and throughput than synchrotron radiation-based techniques, offering new opportunities in the study and development of magnonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了用扫描氮-空位(NV)磁力测量技术（SNVM）对介观坡莫合金结构中的涡旋结构进行静态磁场和微波场的纳米级成像，空间分辨率约50nm，与微磁模拟高度吻合，并揭示了无序效应。研究还展示了涡旋核心附近40倍的微波场增强，并成像了依赖无序度的空间变化倏逝波衰减。
AI.motivation: 纳米尺度自旋波的产生和操控对磁子学和量子技术应用至关重要。虽然此前固定NV中心用于表征涡旋动力学，扫描NV磁力测量仅用于静态杂散场成像，尚无技术能在纳米尺度同时成像涡旋的静态场和微波场。
AI.method: 采用扫描NV磁力测量（SNVM）技术，对介观坡莫合金结构中的磁涡旋进行静态场和微波场的同步成像，分辨率约50nm，并与微磁模拟结果进行对比分析。
AI.result: 实现了静态场和微波场的纳米级成像（约50nm分辨率），与微磁模拟高度一致并揭示了无序效应；在涡旋核心附近观察到40倍微波场增强；成功成像了依赖无序度、空间变化的微波倏逝衰减。
AI.conclusion: 该环境友好的台式技术分辨率比衍射受限技术至少提高5倍，且比同步辐射技术具有更高的可及性和吞吐量，为磁子器件的研究和开发提供了新的机遇。

title: Cell Natural Orbitals in Quantum Materials
summary: Understanding correlated quantum matter starts with an accurate model of the single-particle states that interact at low energies: their dispersion, band geometry, orbital content and charge density. In many cases, notably the topological bands of moire materials, it is not straightforward to find a real-space description with a few local orbitals that accomplishes this task. Here we provide a systematic way to identify the local degrees of freedom that best capture the band geometry and charge density of any chosen set of bands. We use the unit-cell one-particle reduced density matrix (UC-1pRDM), obtained by restricting the projector onto the target bands to a single unit cell. Its eigenstates, which we call cell natural orbitals (CNOs), form a local, symmetric basis uniquely determined by the Bloch wavefunctions and the choice of real-space partition. Their eigenvalues measure the occupation of each CNO in the target bands, quantifying entanglement across unit-cell boundaries and the importance of multi-orbital character. A set of CNOs that maximizes total spectral weight and reproduces the target band symmetries provides optimal trial states for Wannierization. We exemplify this by constructing a lattice model for twisted bilayer WSe$_2$ that tracks the orbital content across twist angles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种系统方法，通过单位胞单粒子约化密度矩阵（UC-1pRDM）的本征态——称为胞自然轨道（CNOs），来识别最能捕获目标能带几何和电荷密度的局域自由度，并以此为瓦尼尔化提供最优试探态。
AI.motivation: 在许多强关联量子材料（特别是莫尔材料的拓扑能带）中，难以找到仅用少数局域轨道就能准确描述单粒子态色散、能带几何、轨道成分和电荷密度的实空间模型，需要一种系统的方法来识别最佳的局域自由度。
AI.method: 将目标能带的投影算子限制到单个单位胞上，构造单位胞单粒子约化密度矩阵（UC-1pRDM），其本征态即为胞自然轨道（CNOs）。这些CNOs形成由布洛赫波函数和实空间划分唯一确定的局域对称基，其本征值度量各CNO在目标能带中的占据数，从而量化跨单位胞边界的纠缠和多轨道特征的重要性。选择总谱权重最大且复现目标能带对称性的CNO集合作为瓦尼尔化的最优试探态。
AI.result: 以扭曲双层WSe₂为例，构建了一个能跨扭转角追踪轨道成分的晶格模型，验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CNO方法提供了一种系统、普适的途径来识别最优局域轨道基组，为复杂量子材料（尤其是莫尔体系）的紧束缚建模和瓦尼尔化提供了可靠框架。

title: High-pressure electride superconductor Li5N for multifunctional applications: A theoretical insight into the physical properties
summary: This study aims to unveil the physical properties of multifunctional Li5N electride under high pressure in the range of 150-350 GPa through first principles analysis within the density functional theory.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算（基于密度泛函理论），在150-350 GPa高压范围内研究了多功能电子化合物Li5N的物理性质。
AI.motivation: 探索高压条件下Li5N电子化合物的物理性质，包括其在极端压力下的结构、电子和其他多功能特性，以揭示其潜在的应用价值。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论框架下的第一性原理计算方法，在150-350 GPa的压力范围内对Li5N电子化合物进行系统的高压物性模拟与分析。
AI.result: 尚未在摘要中给出具体结果，但研究目标是在高压条件下揭示Li5N电子化合物的多功能物理性质。
AI.conclusion: 该研究旨在阐明Li5N在超高压（150-350 GPa）下的物理性质，为理解电子化合物在极端条件下的行为提供理论依据。

title: Steady-state phase transition in one-dimensional hybrid contact process
summary: We investigate the steady-state phase transition in a one-dimensional hybrid contact process. We implement the single-site and cluster mean-field approximations based on the effective fields and present all the possible steady states of the system. We show the existence of the stable absorbing and active phases, and the bistable region in the long-time limit. The saddle-node bifurcation is observed at the boundary between the absorbing phase and the bistable region, suggesting a discontinuous phase transition. While the absorbing to active phase transition is continuous. To characterize the nonclassical scaling behavior of the continuous phase transition, we extract the true critical points and exponents by means of the coherent anomaly method.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维混合接触过程（hybrid contact process）的稳态相变。通过基于有效场的单点和团簇平均场近似，确定了系统的所有可能稳态，发现存在稳定的吸收相、活性相以及双稳态区域。在吸收相与双稳态区域边界观察到鞍结分岔，表明存在不连续相变；而吸收相到活性相的转变是连续的。为表征连续相变的非经典标度行为，使用相干异常方法（coherent anomaly method）提取了真实临界点和临界指数。
AI.motivation: 混合接触过程结合了不同的更新机制，可能表现出不同于标准接触过程的丰富相变行为（如不连续相变）。作者希望系统地刻画该系统的稳态相图，特别是区分连续与不连续相变，并准确提取连续相变的非经典临界指数。
AI.method: 采用基于有效场的单站点（single-site）和团簇（cluster）平均场近似来分析一维混合接触过程；通过稳态分析列举所有可能的系统稳态；借助相干异常方法（Coherent Anomaly Method, CAM）从平均场近似结果中外推真实的临界点和临界指数。
AI.result: 系统存在稳定的吸收相、活性相以及双稳态区域；吸收相与双稳态区域之间的边界出现鞍结分岔，对应不连续（一级）相变；吸收相到活性相的转变为连续（二级）相变。通过相干异常方法成功提取了连续相变的真实临界点与非经典临界指数。
AI.conclusion: 一维混合接触过程同时展现出连续和不连续两种类型的相变，说明混合更新机制能够产生丰富的非平衡相变现象。相干异常方法有效地克服了平均场近似在临界点估计上的偏差，为获取精确的临界行为提供了可靠手段。

title: Real-Time FPGA-Based Multi-Parameter Feedback Stabilization of a Silicon Double Quantum Dot
summary: Long term operation of semiconductor spin qubits requires active stabilization of quantum dot potentials against low-frequency charge noise. Previous work demonstrated a gradient-descent feedback (GDFB) approach on a silicon double quantum dot utilizing transport current measurements. We extend such a GDFB approach in a silicon double quantum dot device with high-bandwidth rf-reflectometry readout by utilizing a field-programmable gate array, the OPX by Quantum Machines, for digital signal processing. The OPX enables continuous multi-parameter gradient calculation and quick gate voltage updates, significantly increasing the effective feedback bandwidth compared to previous work. By operating with 8 steps per feedback cycle and an integration time of 25.6 $μ$s, this high speed stabilization scheme achieves a -6 dB noise suppression up to a bandwidth of 5 kHz. This effectively suppresses low frequency 1/f noise, maintaining device stability over longer time periods, and potentially enables real-time control in large-scale quantum dot arrays.

AI.tldr: 本文在硅双量子点器件中，利用基于FPGA（OPX）的射频反射测量读出技术，扩展了梯度下降反馈（GDFB）方法，实现了高达5 kHz带宽的-6 dB噪声抑制，有效压制低频1/f电荷噪声，维持器件长期稳定性，为大尺度量子点阵列的实时控制提供了可能。
AI.motivation: 半导体自旋量子比特的长期运行需要主动稳定量子点电势以对抗低频电荷噪声，此前已有基于输运电流测量的梯度下降反馈方法，但其反馈带宽受限，亟需提高反馈速度和带宽以实现更有效的噪声抑制。
AI.method: 在硅双量子点器件上，利用Quantum Machines的OPX（基于FPGA）进行数字信号处理，配合高带宽rf-reflectometry读出；每个反馈周期执行8步梯度计算，积分时间为25.6 μs，实现连续多参数梯度计算和快速的栅极电压更新。
AI.result: 该高速稳定化方案实现了高达5 kHz带宽的-6 dB噪声抑制，有效压制低频1/f噪声，并能在更长时间内维持器件稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究显著提升了反馈带宽，展示了实时稳定量子点电势的可行性，有望支撑大规模量子点阵列的实时控制应用。

title: Solver-Agnostic Implementation of Atom-Informed Thermal Conductivity Fields in Continuum Heat-Flow Simulations
summary: A recent work introduced the Simulator Collection for Atomic-to-Continuum Scales (SCACS) toolkit, a framework for improving finite element predictions of heat flow by mapping atom-resolved thermal conductivity into the stiffness matrix of the Galerkin finite element formulation [Ugwumadu et al., Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 053804 (2026)]. Here, we demonstrate that SCACS-derived conductivity fields are solver-independent and can be transferred to existing continuum simulation platforms. As a proof of concept, we map SCACS-derived conductivity fields from complex silicon structures onto finite element meshes in Abaqus and compare the resulting heat-flow solutions with that obtained using conventional uniform-conductivity assignment within Abaqus. Comparison of the two implementations shows that atom-informed conductivity fields can be incorporated into existing finite element workflows and improve realistic prediction and the accuracy of its solution. This work supports broader efforts to improve the predictive capability of continuum simulations for efficient materials design and property prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了SCACS工具包导出的原子级热导率场是求解器无关的，可迁移到现有连续介质仿真平台（如Abaqus），并证明将原子信息嵌入有限元工作流能提高热流预测的真实性和准确性。
AI.motivation: SCACS工具包此前被提出用于将原子分辨热导率映射到Galerkin有限元刚度矩阵中，但其与现有商业连续介质仿真平台的兼容性尚未得到验证。本文旨在证明SCACS导出的热导率场是求解器无关的，可被迁移到Abaqus等现有工具中，从而提升连续介质仿真的预测能力。
AI.method: 将SCACS从复杂硅结构中导出的热导率场映射到Abaqus的有限元网格上，并与Abaqus中传统的均匀热导率分配方法进行对比，比较两种实现下的热流求解结果。
AI.result: 实验对比表明，原子信息感知的热导率场可以无缝整合到现有有限元工作流中，相比均匀热导率分配，能提升预测的真实性和解的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作支持了提升连续介质仿真预测能力的目标，有助于实现更高效的材料设计和性能预测。

title: Observation geometry for uncertainty-aware Hamiltonian inference and experimental design in quantum magnets
summary: Determining microscopic interactions from spectroscopic and scattering measurements is central to understanding quantum materials, yet it often remains unclear which interactions can be reliably revealed by the available experimental data and how additional experimental modalities should be designed to resolve the remaining ambiguities. Here we present an artificial intelligence-enabled framework for uncertainty-aware Hamiltonian inference and adaptive experimental design. By combining Hamiltonian-conditioned neural surrogates with Bayesian inference and observation geometry, the framework characterizes how measurements constrain Hamiltonian parameter space, quantifies the identifiability of microscopic interactions, and propagates posterior uncertainty directly in the physical Hamiltonian parameter space rather than an abstract learned representation. Using multimodal powder and single-crystal inelastic neutron scattering measurements of the quantum magnet NiPS$_{3}$, we demonstrate physically interpretable Hamiltonian inference, modality-aware uncertainty quantification, and adaptive experimental design. The framework provides a general strategy for uncertainty-aware microscopic characterization and multimodal experimental design across quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于人工智能的框架，用于不确定性感知的哈密顿量推断和自适应实验设计。该框架结合哈密顿条件神经代理模型、贝叶斯推断和观测几何，直接在物理哈密顿参数空间中量化测量对参数的约束程度和微观相互作用可辨识性。通过NiPS₃量子磁体的粉末和单晶非弹性中子散射测量进行验证，展示了物理可解释的哈密顿量推断、模态感知的不确定性量化和自适应实验设计。
AI.motivation: 从光谱和散射测量中确定微观相互作用是理解量子材料的关键，但目前尚不清楚哪些相互作用可以由现有实验数据可靠揭示，以及如何设计额外的实验模态来解决剩余的不确定性。现有方法缺乏对哈密顿参数不确定性的系统量化。
AI.method: 提出了一个AI赋能框架，核心包括：(1) 哈密顿条件神经代理模型用于高效前向模拟；(2) 结合贝叶斯推断与观测几何；(3) 直接在物理哈密顿参数空间中传播后验不确定性，而非抽象的隐式表示。框架通过多模态粉末和单晶非弹性中子散射数据进行验证。
AI.result: 在量子磁体NiPS₃上展示了物理可解释的哈密顿量推断、模态感知的不确定性量化以及自适应实验设计能力，验证了框架的有效性和普适性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为量子材料提供了一种通用的不确定性感知微观表征和多模态实验设计策略，有助于解决实验模态设计中的歧义问题。

title: Jamming transition in an active exclusion process
summary: Multiple studies on active matter have shown that activity can induce or suppress a phase transition, or modify the critical behavior of a passive system. Here we investigate how activity affects the jamming transition which is a paradigmatic example of nonequilibrium phase transitions in passive systems. We consider a one-dimensional system of active particles with hardcore interactions and a direction of self-propulsion which can be reversed at a given switching rate. For a class of particle hop rates and infinite switching rate, our model reduces to a passive system which is known to exhibit a transition between a high-density fluid phase and a low-density jammed phase in the stationary state. Using Monte Carlo simulations and a mean field theory, we study how the mean mobility of the particle and the hole cluster distribution vary with density and finite switching rate. Our main result is that activity hinders the formation of jam and can even inhibit it; more precisely, we find that the jamming transition occurs at a critical density that decreases with decreasing switching rate, and at sufficiently small switching rate, the system exists only in the fluid phase.

AI.tldr: 本文研究活性物质如何影响一维硬核粒子系统中的堵塞相变。通过改变粒子的自推进方向切换速率，发现活性会阻碍甚至抑制堵塞现象的形成，堵塞转变的临界密度随切换速率减小而降低，在足够小的切换速率下系统仅存在于流体相。
AI.motivation: 活性物质可以诱导或抑制相变，或改变被动系统的临界行为。堵塞相变是被动系统中非平衡相变的典型例子，但目前尚不清楚活性如何影响这种堵塞相变，因此本文旨在探究活性对堵塞转变的影响机制。
AI.method: 构建一维活性粒子系统，粒子具有硬核相互作用，自推进方向可以以特定切换速率反转。当跳跃速率属于某一类别且切换速率无穷大时，模型退化为已知的被动系统。采用蒙特卡洛模拟和平均场理论，研究粒子平均迁移率和空穴簇分布如何随密度和有限切换速率变化。
AI.result: 主要发现是活性阻碍了堵塞的形成甚至能完全抑制它。具体而言，堵塞转变的临界密度随切换速率的减小而降低；在足够小的切换速率下，系统只存在于流体相，不再出现堵塞相。
AI.conclusion: 活性对堵塞相变具有抑制作用，活性越强（切换速率越小），堵塞越难以形成。这表明活性可以作为调节堵塞转变的有效手段，为理解活性物质中相变行为提供了新见解。

title: Giant mode splitting of azimuthal spin waves in radial vortices
summary: Radial vortex is a topological spin texture stabilized by the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) in ferromagnetic disks. Previous investigations have shown that the doublet splitting of azimuthal modes in traditional circular vortices arises from the coupling between azimuthal spin waves and vortex core (VC), an effect occurs only for azimuthal indices $m=\pm1$ and is absent for higher-order modes. Here, we present a giant mode splitting of azimuthal spin waves in radial vortices, even in the absence of the VC. This mode splitting arises from the DMI, which can be an order of magnitude larger than that induced by the VC. Moreover, the DMI-induced frequency splitting increases with both the DMI constant and mode index, reaching tens of GHz for higher-order azimuthal modes. Our results reveal a robust mechanism for mode splitting in chiral magnetic textures and deepen the fundamental understanding of the DMI effect on the spin-wave dynamics in confined magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了铁磁圆盘中径向涡旋（radial vortex）中方位角自旋波的模式劈裂现象。与传统圆涡旋不同，径向涡旋即使在缺乏涡旋核心的情况下，也能产生巨大的模式劈裂，该劈裂源于界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI），其幅度可比涡旋核心引起的劈裂大一个数量级，且在更高阶模式中可达数十GHz。
AI.motivation: 以往研究仅关注传统圆涡旋中方位角模式的双重劈裂，该劈裂源于方位角自旋波与涡旋核心的耦合，仅对m=±1模式有效。研究者希望探索在手性磁性纹理中是否存在更普遍、更强的模式劈裂机制。
AI.method: 通过理论分析和数值模拟研究径向涡旋中的方位角自旋波动力学，重点分析DMI对模式劈裂的贡献，并与传统圆涡旋中由涡旋核心引起的劈裂进行对比。考察DMI常数和模式指数对劈裂幅度的影响。
AI.result: 发现在径向涡旋中，DMI可以产生巨大的方位角模式劈裂，即使在没有涡旋核心的情况下也能实现。该劈裂幅度可比涡旋核心诱导的劈裂大一个数量级，并随DMI常数和模式指数的增大而增大，在高阶方位角模式中可达数十GHz。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了一种在手性磁性纹理中实现模式劈裂的稳健机制，加深了对受限磁体中DMI对自旋波动力学影响的基本理解。

title: MXene with Janus Structure at Transition metal site -A route to Emergent Properties
summary: Motivated by the discovery of bimetallic MXene compounds with Janus metal sites, we investigate Janus MXenes TiM"CO2, where M" = Mo, W. Our computational analysis reveals that broken inversion symmetry in the Janus structure, coupled with strong spin-orbit coupling at M", generates diverse and remarkable functionalities. These include pronounced Rashba spin splitting, non-trivial Z2 topology, Berry-curvature-dipole-driven nonlinear anomalous Hall effect, and strain control of the Berry curvature dipole. Notably, the 4d transition-metal-based TiMoCO2 and 5d transition-metal-based TiWCO2, with M" elements from the same column of the periodic table, display markedly different behaviors. While TiMoCO2 is a Z2 topological insulator, TiWCO2 is a trivial semimetal. Both compounds, however, exhibit compelling quantum properties. TiWCO2 shows a robust Rashba effect with a large Rashba coefficient of 1.35 eV. Angstrom and a large nonlinear anomalous Hall conductivity of 120 x 0.0001 G0. TiMoCO2, a Z2 narrow-gap semiconductor with weaker Rashba splitting and moderate nonlinear anomalous Hall conductivity, exhibits a strain-driven transition from semiconductor to semimetal. This transition modulates both the sign and magnitude of the Berry curvature dipole, yielding a sizable nonlinear anomalous Hall conductivity of 17 X 0.0001 G0 under 2% tensile strain. Our findings underscore the potential of MXenes as a platform for investigating and tailoring multifunctional quantum phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了双金属MXene化合物TiM"CO2（M"=Mo, W），发现Janus结构打破反演对称性与M"处强自旋轨道耦合协同作用，产生了包括Rashba自旋劈裂、非平凡Z2拓扑、Berry曲率偶极驱动的非线性反常霍尔效应及应变调控在内的多种量子功能。
AI.motivation: 双金属MXene化合物中Janus金属位点的发现为探索新的量子现象提供了契机，本文旨在利用Janus结构打破反演对称性的特性，结合重金属元素的自旋轨道耦合，发掘这类材料中多样化的量子功能。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（computational analysis），系统分析TiMoCO2和TiWCO2的电子结构、自旋轨道耦合效应、Rashba自旋劈裂、Z2拓扑不变量、Berry曲率偶极及非线性反常霍尔电导，并通过施加应变研究其对Berry曲率偶极的调控作用。
AI.result: TiMoCO2为Z2拓扑绝缘体（窄带隙半导体），TiWCO2为平凡半金属。TiWCO2具有强健Rashba效应（系数1.35 eV·Å）和大的非线性反常霍尔电导（120×10⁻⁴ G₀）；TiMoCO2在2%拉伸应变下发生半导体-半金属转变，Berry曲率偶极的符号和大小被调制，产生17×10⁻⁴ G₀的非线性反常霍尔电导。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明MXene平台可作为研究和调控多功能量子现象的理想体系，同族4d与5d过渡金属元素的选择可显著改变量子特性，为多功能量子器件的设计提供了新思路。

title: Role of Goldstone mode in nonequilibrium insulator under DC electric field
comment: 8 figures; submitted to Physical Review B
summary: Measurements of resistive breakdown in electronic systems under a DC electric field have shown that the threshold fields for the insulator-to-metal transition are significantly lower than predicted by single-electron excitation scenarios, such as the Landau-Zener theory. In this work, we propose an alternate mechanism of destabilizing ordered insulators under a DC electric field by fluctuations of the order parameters through the Goldstone mode excitation. The low-energy bosonic excitations receive energy from accelerated electrons and thus destroy the spontaneous symmetry breaking. Using the Keldysh Gree's function formalism, we numerically confirm that the Goldstone mode remains well-defined in the nonequilibrium steady state, while its nonequilibrium excitations are sensitive to the electric field. The effective temperature of the Goldstone mode increases much more rapidly than the electronic effective temperature, with the bosonic threshold field significantly smaller than the electronic one, which suggests that collective phase dynamics may further reduce the transition field to the experimental range via a purely electronic mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在直流电场下使有序绝缘体失稳的新机制：通过Goldstone模激发（序参量的低能玻色子涨落）来破坏自发对称性。利用Keldysh格林函数形式，数值证明Goldstone模在非平衡稳态中保持明确定义，且其有效温度随电场增长远快于电子有效温度，玻色子阈值场远小于电子阈值场，从而将绝缘体-金属转变场降低到实验观测范围。
AI.motivation: 实验观测到直流电场下绝缘体-金属转变的阈值场显著低于单电子激发理论（如Landau-Zener理论）的预测，现有理论无法解释这一差异，需要寻找新的失稳机制。
AI.method: 提出Goldstone模激发作为新的失稳机制，利用Keldysh格林函数形式进行数值计算，分析非平衡稳态下Goldstone模的性质及其对电场的响应，对比玻色子与电子的有效温度和阈值场。
AI.result: 数值结果表明Goldstone模在非平衡稳态中仍保持良定义；其非平衡激发对电场敏感；Goldstone模的有效温度增长速率远快于电子有效温度；玻色子阈值场显著小于电子阈值场。
AI.conclusion: 集体相位动力学可能通过纯电子机制进一步将转变场降低到实验观测范围，为解释实验中电阻击穿阈值场低于理论预测提供了新的物理图像。

title: Moving Analogue Horizons in Stationary Ferroelectrics
summary: We show that a traveling modulation of the polarization-gradient stiffness in a ferroelectric material induces an effective flow in its collective polarization dynamics. Within a controlled local approximation, small polarization fluctuations, or ferrons, obey a massive Klein-Gordon equation with flow. Unlike conventional analogue-gravity platforms, the effective flow originates from the modulation of the material parameters rather than from the physical transport of the medium. This mechanism enables mobile analogue horizons separating sub-ferronic and super-ferronic regions, the latter supporting negative-norm antiferron modes. Their coupling to positive-norm ferrons gives rise to superradiant-like amplification, while the effective mass gap can be tuned independently through an external electric field. Ferroelectric systems therefore provide a novel and experimentally controllable platform for analogue gravity with massive scalar excitations.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了铁电材料中极化梯度刚度的行波调制会在其集体极化动力学中诱导有效流动。在受控的局域近似下，小的极化涨落（铁激子ferrons）遵循带流动的有质量Klein-Gordon方程。与传统类比引力平台不同，这里的有效流动源于材料参数的调制而非介质的物理输运。该机制可实现可移动的类比视界，分隔亚铁激子区和超铁激子区，后者支持负范数反铁激子模式，其与正范数铁激子的耦合产生类似超辐射的放大效应，而有效质量间隙可通过外加电场独立调谐。
AI.motivation: 传统类比引力平台通常依赖于介质的物理运动或流动来模拟引力效应，这在实验控制和平台选择上存在局限。作者希望探索一种新的机制，即通过材料参数的时空调制来产生有效流动，从而在铁电材料这一固态系统中实现类比引力，为研究有质量标量激发提供可控的实验平台。
AI.method: 作者在铁电材料中引入极化梯度刚度的行波调制，采用受控的局域近似，将小的极化涨落（ferrons）描述为满足带有效流动的有质量Klein-Gordon方程。通过分析流动导致的模式分离，考察亚铁激子区与超铁激子区的边界（类比视界），并研究超铁激子区中负范数反铁激子（antiferron）模式与正范数铁激子之间的耦合所引发的超辐射类放大效应。有效质量间隙通过外部电场独立调节。
AI.result: 研究发现在铁电材料中，仅通过调制极化梯度刚度（而非物理输运介质）即可诱导有效流动，从而形成可移动的类比视界。超铁激子区域支持负范数的反铁激子模式，其与正范数铁激子的耦合导致超辐射类放大。此外，有效质量间隙可通过外部电场独立调谐，增强了系统的实验可控性。
AI.conclusion: 铁电系统为类比引力研究提供了一个新颖且实验可控的平台，能支持有质量标量激发（ferrons），其有效流动来源于材料参数的调制，规避了传统平台对物理运动介质的依赖，为探索类比视界、超辐射等现象开辟了新途径。

title: Light Polarization Sensitive Transistor Action in the van der Waals ferroelectric 4H-SnS2
summary: Van der Waals (vdW) ferroelectric semiconductors provide a unique platform for exploring the interplay between spontaneous polarization, electronic transport, ion migration, and photocarrier generation at the nanoscale. Here, we establish a room-temperature ferroelectric state in SnS2 and its sensitivity to structural polytype by directly contrasting the centrosymmetric 2H-phase with the polar 4H-phase. Raman spectroscopy distinguishes the 2H and 4H polymorphs of SnS2 through their characteristic phonon fingerprints. Piezoresponse force microscopy confirms room-temperature ferroelectricity in the 4H phase, while the 2H phase exhibits no ferroelectric response. The built-in polarization in a three-terminal transistor device of the 4H-SnS2 is modulated significantly by electrostatic gating and on exposure to linear and circularly polarized light. This device reveals polarization-controlled output characteristics with distinct gate-voltage induced hysteretic response and thermally activated carrier transport, confirming p-type semiconducting behavior strongly coupled to ferroelectric polarization. The photoresponse likewise exhibits polarization-assisted carrier separation, sublinear power-law scaling, a nonmonotonic temperature response correlated with the characteristic Raman modes, ferroelectric hysteresis, and a pronounced dependence on the circular and linear polarization states of the incident laser beam. These results establish 4H-SnS2 as a promising material system for polarization-driven electronic and optoelectronic technologies, including nonvolatile memory and photoferroelectric functionalities.

AI.tldr: 本文在SnS2中建立了室温铁电态，并通过对比中心对称的2H相与极性4H相，揭示了其对结构多型体的敏感性。Raman光谱和压电力显微镜确认了4H-SnS2的室温铁电性，而三端晶体管器件展示了静电门控和偏振光对极化态的显著调控，以及极化控制的输出特性和光响应，确立了4H-SnS2作为偏振驱动电子和光电子技术的有前景材料平台。
AI.motivation: 范德华铁电半导体为探索自发极化、电子输运、离子迁移和光生载流子之间的相互作用提供了独特平台，但SnS2中的室温铁电态及其与结构多型体的关系尚未被建立和理解。
AI.method: 对比研究2H相（中心对称）和4H相（极性）SnS2多型体；使用Raman光谱区分多型体的声子指纹；利用压电力显微镜（PFM）确认室温铁电性；构建三端晶体管器件，通过静电门控和线/圆偏振光调控内置极化，并测量输出特性、迟滞响应和光电流。
AI.result: Raman光谱可通过特征声子指纹区分2H和4H相；4H相表现出室温铁电性而2H相无铁电响应；4H-SnS2器件的极化受静电门控和偏振光显著调制；器件呈现栅压诱导的迟滞响应、热激活载流子输运和p型半导体行为；光响应表现出偏振辅助载流子分离、亚线性功率标度、与特征Raman模式相关的非单调温度响应、铁电迟滞以及对入射光圆/线偏振态的显著依赖。
