title: Carrier-tunable RKKY magnetism in a crystalline magnet
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures; Supplemental Material: 12 pages, 11 figures, 1 table
summary: In itinerant magnets governed by the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction, the exchange coupling depends on both the moment-moment distance $r$ and the Fermi wavevector $k_{\mathrm{F}}$, yet in bulk synthesis the two are tightly coupled: a change in composition typically alters both. Here, we use a thin-film approach to tune these two variables independently in a single crystalline host. Using molecular-beam epitaxy (MBE), we stabilize either $2\times2\mathrm{R}0^\circ$ Cr$_{1/4}$NbSe$_2$ or $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}\mathrm{R}30^\circ$ Cr$_{1/3}$NbSe$_2$ within the same NbSe$_2$ host through separate growth windows. Controlled post-growth annealing performed across a series of temperatures then modifies the carrier density while leaving the Cr superstructure intact below a structural-transition threshold. The two as-grown phases are distinct in electronic structure, magnetic ground state, and transport. Along this annealing series, the Hall response evolves systematically while the magnetic response changes in a structurally insensitive manner, with ferromagnetic order emerging within the same $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}\mathrm{R}30^\circ$ structural class only above a critical annealing temperature, experimentally disentangling carrier density and moment geometry. The Hall magnitude and sign evolution point to a low-carrier-density system in which $k_{\mathrm{F}}$ is susceptible to modest external tuning. Cr-NbSe$_2$ thus realizes carrier-sensitive RKKY magnetism in a single crystalline host, within an MBE-plus-annealing approach extensible across the intercalated transition-metal dichalcogenide family.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分子束外延（MBE）结合可控退火，在单一NbSe₂晶格中独立调控Cr插层浓度（决定磁矩间距r）和载流子密度（决定费米波矢k_F），成功解耦RKKY交换耦合中两个紧密耦合的变量，首次实验性地将载流子密度与磁矩几何效应分离，实现了载流子敏感的RKKY磁性调控。
AI.motivation: 在RKKY相互作用的巡游磁体中，交换耦合同时依赖磁矩间距r和费米波矢k_F，但体相合成中两者紧密耦合——改变成分通常会同时改变二者。作者希望通过薄膜方法在单一晶体宿主中独立调节这两个变量，以实验上解耦它们对磁性的影响。
AI.method: 利用分子束外延（MBE）在同一NbSe₂宿主中通过不同的生长窗口分别稳定2×2R0° Cr₁/₄NbSe₂和√3×√3R30° Cr₁/₃NbSe₂两种结构。随后在系列温度下进行受控退火，在保持Cr超结构完整（低于结构转变阈值）的前提下改变载流子密度，从而独立调控k_F。
AI.result: 两种非退火相在电子结构、磁基态和输运性质上截然不同。退火系列中，霍尔响应系统性演化而磁响应在结构上不敏感；仅在超过临界退火温度后，同一√3×√3R30°结构类内才出现铁磁序，实验上将载流子密度与磁矩几何效应分离。霍尔响应的幅值和符号演化表明该系统为低载流子密度体系，k_F对温和的外部调控敏感。
AI.conclusion: Cr-NbSe₂在单一晶体宿主中实现了载流子敏感的RKKY磁性，其MBE加退火的方法可扩展至整个插层过渡金属二硫族化合物（TMD）家族，为系统研究RKKY磁性中载流子调控提供了新的材料平台。

title: Exact First-Passage Time Response Theory from Steady-State Response
comment: 7+10 pages, 3 figures. See also our companion paper [arXiv:2608.06368]
summary: The mean first-passage time (MFPT) provides a universal temporal measure of transport, reaction, search, and switching processes in physical, chemical, and biological systems. Understanding how MFPTs respond to perturbations is therefore crucial for prediction and control, yet a systematic theory has been lacking. We establish a compact theoretical framework for linear and nonlinear MFPT response in continuous-time Markov processes. The key tool is an exact correspondence that maps the intrinsically transient response of MFPTs onto the steady-state response of an auxiliary system. This correspondence yields exact and universal response relations for MFPTs between arbitrary state pairs, expressed entirely in terms of unperturbed MFPTs and steady-state probabilities. We then obtain a factorized physical decomposition of the MFPT response into linear upstream, linear downstream, and nonlinear contributions. Further corollaries include response-curve inference rules, fundamental bounds on MFPT responses, analytical expressions for higher-order responses of MFPTs and steady-state probabilities, and multi-rate response formulas. Additionally, our result offers computational advantages in calculating both MFPTs and steady-state distributions. Finally, a biologically motivated folding network is analyzed, and a recently reported paradox on MFPT is clarified.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了连续时间马尔可夫过程中MFPT对扰动的线性和非线性响应理论框架。核心工具是一个精确对应关系，将MFPT的瞬态响应映射到辅助系统的稳态响应上，从而得到用未扰动MFPT和稳态概率表示的普适响应关系，并进一步分解为线性上游、线性下游和非线性贡献。
AI.motivation: MFPT是物理、化学和生物系统中输运、反应、搜索和切换过程的普适时间度量，理解其对扰动的响应对于预测和控制至关重要，但此前缺乏系统的理论框架。
AI.method: 建立一个精确对应关系，将MFPT的内在瞬态响应映射到辅助系统的稳态响应上；由此推导出任意状态对之间MFPT的精确普适响应关系，仅用未扰动MFPT和稳态概率表达；进而获得因子化的物理分解（线性上游、线性下游和非线性贡献），并推导出响应曲线推断规则、基本界、高阶响应解析式和多速率响应公式。
AI.result: 获得了精确且普适的MFPT响应关系，实现了物理分解，得到响应曲线推断规则、MFPT响应的基本界、MFPT和稳态概率的高阶响应解析式以及多速率响应公式；在计算MFPT和稳态分布上具有计算优势；并成功分析了一个生物学折叠网络，澄清了近期报道的MFPT悖论。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为MFPT对扰动的响应提供了统一、紧凑且普适的理论，兼具预测、控制与计算优势，并通过生物折叠网络实例验证了其实用价值，澄清了已有的悖论。

title: Dynamics of amorphous membranes in the two-dimensional limit
summary: Atomically thin mechanical resonators have been realized predominantly in crystalline two-dimensional (2D) materials, such as graphene, where long-range crystalline order sets their elastic properties and defines their nonlinear resonant behavior. Extending these concepts to the amorphous 2D limit has remained largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate that monolayer amorphous carbon (MAC) forms suspended membranes that support optothermal actuation and sensitive interferometric readout across both linear and nonlinear regimes of its resonant motion. We resolve thermomechanical motion, driven resonances, and multimode spectra in MAC nanodrums. The frequencies of fundamental vibration modes correspond to unusually low pretensions, placing monolayer MAC nanodrums in a regime where geometric nonlinearities, stress heterogeneity, and mode coupling emerge at comparatively low drive powers. Consistently, we observe pronounced nonlinear dynamics, including hardening, softening, and mixed Duffing responses, nonlinear damping, parametrically excited modes, and signatures of intermodal coupling. These results establish MAC as a robust nanoelectromechanical platform and open an experimental route to disorder-governed nanomechanics in the 2D amorphous limit.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实验演示了单层非晶碳（MAC）可形成悬浮膜，支持光热驱动和干涉测量读出的线性和非线性谐振运动，建立了MAC作为无序主导的二维纳米机电平台。
AI.motivation: 先前原子级薄的机械谐振器几乎完全局限于晶体二维材料（如石墨烯），其弹性性质由长程有序决定。将这一概念扩展到非晶二维极限尚未被探索，因此本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 制备单层非晶碳（MAC）悬浮膜，利用光热驱动和灵敏干涉测量进行读出，在谐振运动的线性和非线性区域进行表征，包括热机械运动、驱动谐振和多模谱分析。
AI.result: MAC纳米鼓的基频振动模式对应异常低的预应力，使几何非线性、应力异质性和模式耦合在较低的驱动功率下即可出现。观测到明显的非线性动力学，包括硬化、软化和混合Duffing响应、非线性阻尼、参数激发模式以及模态间耦合的特征。
AI.conclusion: MAC被确立为一种稳健的纳米机电平台，为二维非晶极限下的无序支配纳米力学开辟了实验途径。

title: Revealing the Atomic Structure of NiO/Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ Interfaces
summary: NiO/Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ heterojunctions have garnered significant attention for use in power electronics due to the ultrawide bandgap and wafer-scale availability of Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ and the controllable p-type doping of NiO. However, the structure of NiO/Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ interfaces remains underexplored, largely due to the complexity of the junction between their dissimilar cubic and monoclinic crystal structures. Here we investigate the atomistic structure of the NiO/Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ interface for (100), (-201), and (001) oriented Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ substrates using aberration-corrected scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) in combination with interface modeling and image simulations. We evaluate the abruptness and consistency of the interfaces and compare them to calculated interface models, proposing precise atomic structures and assessing potential structural variation arising from complexity of the monoclinic Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ crystal structure. Our interface analysis supports increased focus on (100) oriented Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ as a candidate for fabricating high quality, low defect density NiO/Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ heterojunction devices. Importantly, we consider the effects of specimen thickness and 3D-to-2D projection during the STEM imaging process to differentiate such effects from real crystal variations. This work provides insight into the effect of substrate orientation on NiO film and interface quality, creating a pathway to improving heterojunction properties. It further highlights important considerations for interpretation of stability and interlayer phase formation in these interfaces, which is crucial for their integration into reliable and robust power electronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文利用像差校正扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）结合界面建模和图像模拟，系统研究了NiO/Ga₂O₃异质结界面的原子结构，针对(100)、(-201)和(001)三种取向的Ga₂O₃衬底进行了对比分析，提出精确的界面原子构型，并指出(100)取向Ga₂O₃是制备高质量、低缺陷密度NiO/Ga₂O₃异质结器件的优选候选。
AI.motivation: NiO/Ga₂O₃异质结因其超宽禁带和可控p型掺杂在功率电子器件中备受关注，但界面的原子结构研究不足，主要原因是立方NiO与单斜Ga₂O₃晶体结构不匹配导致界面结构复杂，亟需深入理解衬底取向对界面质量的影响。
AI.method: 采用像差校正扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）对(100)、(-201)、(001)三种取向Ga₂O₃衬底上的NiO/Ga₂O₃界面进行原子级表征，结合界面理论建模和图像模拟进行对比验证，同时考虑样品厚度和3D到2D投影效应对STEM成像的影响，以区分成像伪影与真实的晶体结构变化。
AI.result: 本研究评估了不同取向界面的陡峭性和一致性，提出了精确的界面原子结构模型，并指出(100)取向Ga₂O₃更适合制备高质量、低缺陷密度的NiO/Ga₂O₃异质结器件。研究还揭示了衬底取向对NiO薄膜质量和界面质量的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作阐明了衬底取向对NiO/Ga₂O₃异质结界面质量的影响机制，为提升异质结性能开辟了新途径，同时强调了界面稳定性判读和中间层相形成分析的重要性，对功率电子器件的可靠集成具有关键意义。

title: Quantum Mechanism of Piezomagnetism in Higher-Spin Altermagnets
summary: We investigate piezomagnetism in higher-spin altermagnets with easy-plane single-ion anisotropy using a flavor-wave approach. We show that quantum fluctuations of higher-spin collective modes provide a microscopic origin of the piezomagnetic response. For integer spins, the relevant branch softens and evolves into a Higgs-like amplitude mode on approaching the large-$D$ transition, endowing the excitation with a sizable dipolar component and producing a pronounced enhancement of piezomagnetism. By contrast, in half-integer systems the higher-spin branches are progressively separated from the low-energy dipolar sector as the anisotropy increases, which suppresses their contribution to the response. This integer-half-integer contrast directly links macroscopic piezomagnetism to the low-energy fate of multipolar excitations. Our results establish piezomagnetism as a probe of higher-spin quantum dynamics and identify higher-spin altermagnets as a promising setting for quantum magnetoelastic responses.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用flavor-wave方法研究了具有易平面单离子各向异性的高阶自旋交替磁体中的压磁效应，发现量子涨落是压磁响应的微观起源。整数自旋系统中相关支路软化演化为Higgs-like振幅模式，显著增强压磁效应；而半整数自旋系统中高阶支路被分离，抑制了压磁贡献。
AI.motivation: 揭示高阶自旋交替磁体中压磁效应的微观起源，特别是量子涨落和多极激发在其中的作用，并探索整数与半整数自旋系统之间的本质差异。
AI.method: 采用flavor-wave方法研究具有易平面单离子各向异性的高阶自旋交替磁体，分析不同自旋（整数与半整数）条件下集体模式的量子涨落及其对压磁响应的贡献。
AI.result: 整数自旋系统中，相关支路在大D相变附近软化并演化为Higgs-like振幅模式，赋予激发显著的偶极分量，从而大幅增强压磁效应；半整数系统中，高阶自旋支路随各向异性增大逐渐与低能偶极扇区分离，抑制了压磁响应。
AI.conclusion: 压磁效应可作为探测高阶自旋量子动力学的灵敏工具，高阶自旋交替磁体是实现量子磁弹性响应的有前景材料平台。整数/半整数自旋的对比直接揭示了宏观压磁性与多极激发低能行为之间的内在联系。

title: Universal scaling of spatially extended zero modes in inhomogeneous SSH chains
summary: Protected zero modes are a hallmark of topological phases of matter and are exponentially localized at sharp interfaces between distinct gapped phases. We investigate how this picture changes for smooth interfaces in a broad class of inhomogeneous Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) models. Combining an exact lattice solution with an inhomogeneous Dirac description, we show that the associated Jackiw-Rebbi zero mode becomes spatially extended. For arbitrary smooth hopping profiles, its lattice extension universally scales as the square root of the system size, independently of the microscopic details of the interface. This emergent length defines a mesoscopic critical region separating two gapped phases, within which correlations decay algebraically before crossing over to exponential decay. In addition, the entanglement entropy scales as the logarithm of the emergent length near the interface, confirming the interpretation of a mesoscopic critical region. Our results establish a universal critical length governing the low-energy physics of smooth topological interfaces.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了不均匀Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型中平滑界面对拓扑零模的影响。结合精确晶格解和非均匀狄拉克描述，作者发现Jackiw-Rebbi零模在平滑界面处会空间扩展，其晶格延伸长度普遍与系统尺寸的平方根成正比，与界面微观细节无关。该涌现长度定义了一个介观临界区域，其中关联呈代数衰减，纠缠熵与该长度的对数成正比。
AI.motivation: 拓扑零模通常被认为在尖锐界面处呈指数局域化，但自然界中实际界面往往不是尖锐的而是平滑的。作者希望理解平滑界面如何改变这一经典图景，并探究是否存在普遍的物理规律。
AI.method: 作者结合精确晶格求解与非均匀狄拉克方程描述，对广泛类别的非均匀SSH模型进行解析分析，研究平滑跳跃轮廓下的零模行为、关联函数衰减及纠缠熵。
AI.result: 研究发现平滑界面的零模扩展长度普遍按系统尺寸的平方根缩放，与界面微观细节无关；该区域表现为介观临界区，关联呈代数衰减后过渡到指数衰减；纠缠熵随涌现长度的对数增长。
AI.conclusion: 确立了平滑拓扑界面低能物理的普适临界长度，为理解真实材料中拓扑界面行为提供了新的理论框架。

title: Higher-Order Topological States with Cleavage-Dependent Dirac Mass
summary: Topological quantum chemistry based on local charge profiles lacks predictive power for the crystalline cleavage of higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs). By cleaving an obstructed atomic insulator, we discover a topological phase characterized by e/2 fractional charges localized at precisely half of the corners, while the remaining empty corners host complementary vacancies of interstice charge. These zero-energy charge-vacancies and topological corners form a spatially balanced geometry, confined separately by C2 rotation symmetry. Crucially, we demonstrate that the emergence of corner zero modes dictates that specific dangling bonds-acting as the mass of a Dirac fermion-must explicitly expose in, and subtly slope toward, the corner regions. This strict directionality is verified by the anisotropic evolution of the mass term within a (2+1)-dimensional parameter space. Moreover, we find that the topological corners acquire lower entanglement entropy compared to the bulk, a behavior opposite to that of the real-space energy distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文通过剖切阻塞原子绝缘体，发现一种高阶拓扑绝缘体（HOTI）拓扑相，其特征为e/2分数电荷精确局域在恰好一半的角上，而其余空角容纳间隙电荷的互补空位。这些零能电荷空位与拓扑角形成空间平衡几何，由C2旋转对称性分别约束。研究表明角零模的出现要求特定悬挂键（作为狄拉克费米子的质量项）必须在角区域显式暴露并微妙倾斜，该方向性通过(2+1)维参数空间中质量项的各向异性演化得到验证。此外，拓扑角相比体态具有更低的纠缠熵，这与实空间能量分布的行为相反。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于局域电荷分布的拓扑量子化学方法缺乏对高阶拓扑绝缘体晶体解理行为的预测能力，需要新的理论框架来理解HOTI中的拓扑相及其角态特性。
AI.method: 通过剖切阻塞原子绝缘体来构造高阶拓扑绝缘体系统，利用C2旋转对称性分析分数电荷的空间分布与电荷空位的互补性，并通过(2+1)维参数空间中的质量项各向异性演化和纠缠熵计算来验证拓扑角态的性质。
AI.result: 发现e/2分数电荷局域于一半的角上，空角容纳互补的间隙电荷空位；角零模的出现要求悬挂键（狄拉克质量项）在角区域显式暴露并向角内倾斜；拓扑角具有比体态更低的纠缠熵，与实空间能量分布相反。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了HOTI角态的新颖拓扑特征——电荷-空位空间平衡几何、悬挂键质量项的严格方向性，以及拓扑角纠缠熵低于体态的反直觉行为，为高阶拓扑绝缘体的晶体解理预测提供了新的理论见解。

title: Balanced electron and phonon heat transport in metallic $\varepsilon$-TaN
summary: Most materials with high thermal conductivity belong to one of two classes: metals, where heat is carried predominantly by electrons, and insulators, where heat transport is dominated by the phonon contribution. Materials that combine substantial electronic thermal conductivity and lattice thermal conductivity are rare, because the mechanisms that favor electron transport typically suppress phonon transport, and vice versa. Here, we report the theoretical prediction and experimental realization of such a material, metallic $\varepsilon$-TaN. Our calculations predict a total thermal conductivity at room-temperature of 273$\pm$5Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ in single crystals and 145$\pm$5Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ in polycrystals with 0.5$μ$m grains, with an unusually large lattice contribution (79%) for a metal. The latter value is in agreement with our local transient thermoreflectance measurements on polycrystalline samples yielding $\sim$130Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$. We show that the balanced electronic and lattice thermal conductivities of $\varepsilon$-TaN originate from a combination of large Fermi velocity and small Fermi density of states on the electron side, and large speed of sound and wide phonon gap on the lattice side.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了金属ε-TaN这一罕见的兼具高电子热导率和高晶格热导率的材料。理论上预测单晶室温总热导率为273±5 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹，多晶（0.5μm晶粒）为145±5 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹，其中晶格贡献高达79%（对金属而言异常高）。实验通过瞬态热反射法测得多晶样品约130 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹，与理论一致。
AI.motivation: 大多数高热导率材料分为两类：金属（电子主导导热）和绝缘体（声子主导导热）。同时具备较高电子热导率和晶格热导率的材料极为罕见，因为有利于电子输运的机制通常会抑制声子输运，反之亦然。因此，寻找并实现这种“平衡型”双通道导热材料具有重要的科学意义。
AI.method: 理论方面：通过第一性原理计算预测ε-TaN的热导率及电子/晶格输运性质。实验方面：利用局部瞬态热反射法（transient thermoreflectance）测量多晶样品的实际热导率，并与理论预测进行对比验证。
AI.result: 理论预测单晶室温总热导率为273±5 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹，多晶（0.5μm晶粒）为145±5 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹，晶格贡献占79%（对金属而言异常高）。实验测量多晶样品热导率约130 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹，与理论值吻合。
AI.conclusion: ε-TaN实现电子和晶格热导率的平衡源于两方面：电子侧具有大的费米速度和小的费米态密度；晶格侧具有大的声速和宽的声子带隙。这种独特组合使ε-TaN成为兼具双通道高导热的金属材料。

title: Spin Splitter without Spin-Split Bands: A Reconfigurable Altermagnetic Texture
summary: The altermagnetic spin-splitter effect converts an electric field into a transverse pure spin current, with no net magnetization and no charge-Hall counterpart. In established materials this function is tied to crystal-fixed spin-split bands that lock the polarization axis to the lattice. We show that the noncoplanar counter-spiral ground state of a frustrated honeycomb magnet instead carries the altermagnetic operation through a $\mathbf Q$-locked helicity mirror $g$. The mirror selects the spin-current polarization and forbids the perpendicular one, while an antitranslation $Θ$ forbids even-parity spin splitting. Band splitting and spin-splitter response therefore rest on different symmetry elements. Either element alone enforces the charge-Hall zero---a redundancy absent from other spin--orbit-free noncollinear routes---and a charge Hall appears only when both elements are removed. Hole doping then realizes a \emph{spin splitter without spin-split bands}---the symmetry-allowed odd-parity residual below $2\times10^{-7}$ of the hopping $t$ at the Fermi level---with $σ_H^{(s_y)}=0.082\,e^2/h$ without spin--orbit coupling and with zero charge Hall response. Selecting among the three degenerate $\mathbf{Q}$ orientations rotates the polarization axis in exact $120^\circ$ steps at fixed magnitude and charge-Hall zero; the selection rules persist in a $32$-site cell accessible to programmable photonic and circuit lattices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种在受挫蜂窝磁体中实现的自旋分裂效应（altermagnetic spin-splitter effect）。在该磁体的非共面反螺旋基态中，一个由Q矢量锁定的螺旋镜面g驱动了自旋电流的极化选择，而反对平移操作Θ则禁止了偶宇称自旋劈裂。研究发现，能带劈裂和自旋分裂响应分别由不同的对称元素控制，且两者单独存在都足以保证电荷霍尔效应为零。通过空穴掺杂，该体系实现了"无自旋劈裂能带的自旋分裂器"，自旋霍尔电导σ_H^(s_y)=0.082 e²/h，且无自旋轨道耦合、电荷霍尔响应为零。
AI.motivation: 传统的自旋分裂效应材料依赖晶体固定的自旋劈裂能带，将极化轴锁定在晶格上。作者希望探索在受挫磁性体系中能否通过非共线自旋结构实现这种功能，并探究自旋劈裂能带与自旋分裂响应之间的深层对称性关系。
AI.method: 作者分析了受挫蜂窝磁体的非共面反螺旋基态，识别出其携带的对称元素：Q锁定的螺旋镜面g（选择自旋电流极化方向）和反对平移Θ（禁止偶宇称自旋劈裂）。通过对称性分析区分了能带劈裂与自旋分裂响应的不同对称性来源，并在32位点元胞中验证了选择规则。
AI.result: 实现了无自旋轨道耦合的自旋分裂器，自旋霍尔电导为0.082 e²/h，电荷霍尔响应为零。费米能级处对称性允许的奇宇称残余低于跳跃积分t的2×10⁻⁷，三个简并的Q取向选择可使极化轴精确旋转120°且保持幅值不变。与传统非共线路线不同，该体系具有冗余的对称性保护使电荷霍尔为零。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了一种新的自旋分裂效应实现范式：在非共线反螺旋磁性基态中，自旋分裂响应与自旋劈裂能带可解耦——两者由不同对称元素控制。这一发现为在无自旋轨道耦合体系中设计自旋无磁性输运器件提供了新途径，且该结构可在可编程光子与电路晶格中实现。

title: Topological states of generalized dissipative Majorana wires
summary: We study the generalized one-dimensional (1D) quantum dissipative models corresponding to a Majorana wire which can possess more than one Majorana bound state at each end. The system consists of a 1D fermionic open quantum system whose dynamics is governed by a quadratic Lindblad equation. Using the adjoint Lindblad equation for the fermionic two-point correlations, we find the gaps in the damping and purity spectra of a generic 1D model. Then, using the symmetry-based classification, we show that a winding number as the topological invariant can be defined which distinguishes different steady states of the system in the presence of damping and purity gaps. Then we focus on certain models with different Lindblad quantum jump terms and explore their phase diagrams by calculating the damping and the purity gaps as well as the winding number. In particular, we show that by inclusion of quantum jumps between next-nearest-neighbor sites, higher winding numbers and, equivalently, more Majorana bound states can be achieved. Also, by introducing imbalanced couplings, we can switch between states with negative and positive winding numbers. Finally, we should mention that since our formulation is based on the fermionic correlations rather than the Majorana operators, it can be easily extended to the dissipative topological phases belonging to other symmetry classes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究广义一维量子耗散模型（Majorana线），该系统可在一端拥有多个马约拉纳束缚态。作者通过二次Lindblad方程描述一维费米子开放量子系统，利用伴随Lindblad方程求阻尼谱和纯度谱的能隙，并基于对称性分类定义拓扑不变量（缠绕数）来区分不同稳态。研究发现加入次近邻量子跳变项可获得更高缠绕数和更多马约拉纳束缚态，而引入非平衡耦合可在正负缠绕数之间切换。
AI.motivation: 扩展一维量子耗散模型中马约拉纳束缚态的研究，使其能够在一端支持多个马约拉纳束缚态，并探究如何通过调节系统参数（如量子跳变项、耦合强度）来实现更高阶的拓扑量子态，从而丰富耗散拓扑相的分类与调控手段。
AI.method: 采用二次Lindblad方程描述一维费米子开放量子系统动力学；通过伴随Lindblad方程求解费米子两点关联函数，计算阻尼谱和纯度谱的能隙；利用对称性分类方法定义缠绕数作为拓扑不变量；针对不同Lindblad量子跳变项的模型，数值计算相图并分析缠绕数变化。
AI.result: 证明了在阻尼谱和纯度谱存在能隙的条件下，缠绕数可作为拓扑不变量区分不同稳态。在包含次近邻量子跳变项的模型中实现了更高的缠绕数（等价于更多马约拉纳束缚态）；通过引入非平衡耦合可实现在正负缠绕数之间切换。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为耗散拓扑相的调控提供了新途径，即通过设计量子跳变项和调节耦合平衡度来控制马约拉纳束缚态的数量与拓扑性质。由于公式化基于费米子关联而非马约拉纳算子，该方法可自然推广到其他对称性类的耗散拓扑相研究。

title: Helimagnetism from competing intra- and interchain interactions in CrBr$_2$ and CrI$_2$
summary: CrBr$_2$ and CrI$_2$ are promising platforms for studying the effect of dimensionality on magnetic order, having been isolated in a 3-, 2-, and 1-dimensional form as bulk crystals, monolayers, and individual chains encapsulated in carbon nanotubes. However, the interactions that give rise to their helimagnetic order are unknown. Via inelastic neutron scattering on single crystals, we have determined the exchange interactions of these compounds from the spin wave dispersions, finding that the helimagnetic order arises primarily from competing antiferromagnetic interactions between intrachain and interchain nearest-neighbors. Single-ion anisotropy is substantial, modulating the helical spin rotation and gapping the inelastic intensity at points of branch crossings. As temperature increases, long-range order vanishes but intralayer correlations remain detectable up to at least 50 K.

AI.tldr: 通过非弹性中子散射实验，测定了CrBr₂和CrI₂单晶的自旋波色散关系，确定了其交换相互作用，发现螺旋磁有序主要源于链内和链间最近邻反铁磁相互作用的竞争，且单离子各向异性显著。
AI.motivation: CrBr₂和CrI₂可作为研究维度对磁性有序影响的平台（体相、单层、碳纳米管中的一维链），但其螺旋磁有序的相互作用机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用非弹性中子散射技术，在单晶样品上测量自旋波色散关系，从而提取交换相互作用参数。
AI.result: 发现螺旋磁有序主要由链内与链间最近邻反铁磁相互作用的竞争产生；单离子各向异性显著，调制螺旋自旋旋转并在分支交叉点处使非弹性强度产生能隙；温度升高时长程有序消失，但层内关联在50 K以上仍可探测到。
AI.conclusion: 确定了CrBr₂和CrI₂磁性相互作用的微观起源，为理解这两个化合物中维度效应对磁有序的影响提供了实验基础。

title: Influence of interactions on the chiral effect in $1D$ Dirac semimetal
summary: We consider the 1D Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model. It was recently shown that, for the noninteracting model in its Dirac semimetal phase, the linear response of the axial charge density to an external electric field is proportional to the electrical conductivity in the presence of finite dissipation, with the proportionality factor determined by the coupling constants. This relation may be viewed as a manifestation of the chiral effect, which is a dimensional reduction of the 3D chiral magnetic effect. In the present work, we investigate the same model in the presence of two versions of local Hubbard-type interactions using numerical Quantum Monte Carlo simulations. We find, within the numerical resolution and for the parameters studied, that, even in the regime where sufficiently strong interactions drive the system into a Mott insulating phase, the proportionality between the induced axial charge density and the electrical conductivity remains unchanged. This result indicates that the chiral effect is not renormalized by local Hubbard interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过量子蒙特卡洛数值模拟研究了1D SSH模型中手性效应在局域Hubbard相互作用下的表现，发现在Mott绝缘相中，轴向电荷密度与电导率之间的比例关系保持不变，表明手性效应不受局域Hubbard相互作用重整化。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明非相互作用SSH模型的Dirac半金属相中，轴向电荷密度对电场的线性响应与电导率成正比（手性效应，即3D手性磁效应的维度约化）。作者希望探究局域Hubbard型相互作用是否会改变这一比例关系。
AI.method: 在1D SSH模型中引入两种局域Hubbard型相互作用，采用数值量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）模拟方法，研究从弱相互作用到强相互作用驱动系统进入Mott绝缘相的整个过程中，轴向电荷密度与电导率之间的比例关系。
AI.result: 在数值分辨率和所研究参数范围内，即使强相互作用使系统进入Mott绝缘态，诱导轴向电荷密度与电导率之间的正比关系仍然保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 该结果表明局部Hubbard相互作用不会对手性效应产生重整化作用，手性效应在相互作用存在时依然成立。

title: Geometric Phonon Energy Pumping in a Layer-Hybridized Moiré Exciton Manifold
summary: Slow cyclic modulation of an open quantum system can generate a geometric contribution to its energy transfer statistics, separable from the dynamic background. In this work we construct an experimentally anchored four state open system model for a gate-tunable WSe2/WS2 moiré exciton manifold within a population level full counting statistics framework. We first drive the system uniformly through a closed gate and pump loop and separate the geometric contribution from the dynamic background by reversing the loop direction. We then examine how this response changes with environmental rates, exciton coupling, control conditions, and static spectral broadening. A shorter cycle period followed by nonuniform traversal of the driving loop substantially improves detectability while preserving the geometric response. Combined with enhanced phonon relaxation and reduced radiative loss, this gives about a fourteenfold fixed time signal to noise gain relative to the uniform loop. Our results show that the geometric phonon response remains robust against realistic variations in the system and its environment, and that we can improve its detectability more effectively by suppressing dynamical noise through frequency modulated driving.

AI.tldr: 本文在人口级全计数统计框架下，构建了一个实验锚定的四态开放系统模型，用于研究WSe2/WS2莫尔激子流形在慢循环调制下的几何能量传递统计贡献。通过反转环路方向将几何贡献与动态背景分离，发现短周期与非均匀驱动可显著提高可探测性，结合增强的声子弛豫和降低的辐射损失，可获得约14倍的固定时间信噪比增益。
AI.motivation: 慢循环调制开放量子系统可产生几何贡献于能量转移统计中，但该贡献如何与动态背景分离并提高其可探测性尚不清楚。作者希望利用实验相关的WSe2/WS2莫尔异质结系统，在真实可调条件下研究几何声子响应的鲁棒性和探测优化策略。
AI.method: 构建实验锚定的四态开放系统模型，采用人口级全计数统计框架；通过闭合栅极与泵浦环路均匀驱动系统，并反转环路方向以分离几何贡献与动态背景；系统考察环境速率、激子耦合、控制条件及静态谱展宽对响应的影响；尝试非均匀环路遍历与频率调制驱动以抑制动态噪声。
AI.result: 短周期结合非均匀环路遍历可保持几何响应同时显著提升可探测性；结合增强的声子弛豫和减少的辐射损失，相对均匀环路实现约十四倍的固定时间信噪比增益；几何声子响应在系统和环境的现实变化下保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 几何声子响应在现实中是稳健的，且通过频率调制驱动抑制动态噪声，比直接增强几何信号更能有效提高其可探测性。

title: On the Importance of Geometric Nonlinearity and Temperature-Dependent Properties in Multi-Material Thermo-Mechanical Topology Optimization
summary: Thermo-mechanical compliant devices are commonly designed with small-strain linear elasticity and temperature-independent material properties, even though they might operate hundreds of kelvin above ambient where both assumptions are questionable. In this work, we quantify the effect and cost of each assumption in multi-material topology optimization of thermally actuated compliant devices. To this end, we introduce a physics-informed, simultaneous analysis-and-design framework with (i) a finite-strain quadratic-Hencky (logarithmic-strain) constitutive model whose isotropic thermal eigenstrain admits an exact additive split in log-strain space, and (ii) temperature-dependent conductivity, thermal expansion, and elastic moduli for a titanium--copper--steel material system. We optimize a thermal actuator and a thermal gripper at three design temperatures under both a baseline model and the full physics, subject to mass and manufacturability constraints. Every converged design is re-evaluated by verified nonlinear finite element solvers in the full factorial of constitutive law and property model. The comparison between the two factors reveals that the constitutive law is the decisive modeling choice: These devices work as linkages where linear kinematics mistakes rotation for compressive strain; its error therefore grows with the design temperature and concentrates on the very layouts that exploit rotation best. Because a linear optimizer also steers away from the rotation-rich mechanisms that would expose this bias, the model can deceptively appear trustworthy when validated against its own designs. Designing with the full physics yields consistently stronger and more temperature-robust devices at a modest increase in design-time cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了热机械柔顺器件多材料拓扑优化中两个常用假设（小应变线弹性与温度无关材料属性）的影响与代价，提出了基于物理的同步分析与设计框架，包含有限应变二次Hencky本构模型和温度相关材料属性，并通过热执行器与热夹持器的优化验证，发现本构模型是决定性建模选择。
AI.motivation: 热机械柔顺器件常工作于高出环境数百开尔文的温度下，但传统设计采用小应变线性弹性与温度无关材料属性的假设，这些假设在高温下可能失效。量化这些假设的影响与代价是必要的。
AI.method: 引入物理信息驱动的同步分析与设计框架，包含：(i)有限应变二次Hencky（对数应变）本构模型，其各向同性热特征应变更允许在对数应变空间精确加性分解；(ii)钛-铜-钢材料系统中随温度变化的导热系数、热膨胀和弹性模量。在基线模型与完整物理模型下，于三个设计温度优化热执行器和热夹持器，并受质量与可制造性约束。
AI.result: 每个收敛设计均通过经过验证的非线性有限元求解器在本构律与属性模型的全析因组合下重新评估。对比显示本构律是决定性建模选择：这些器件如同连杆机构，线性运动学会将转动误判为压应变，误差随设计温度增长且集中于最充分利用转动的布局。线性优化器还会避开暴露此偏差的旋转丰富机制，使模型在针对自身设计验证时看似可信。使用完整物理设计能获得更强、温度鲁棒性更好的器件，且设计时间成本增加适中。
AI.conclusion: 本构模型（线性有限应变 vs 非线性有限应变）是热机械柔顺器件优化中的关键建模决策，而非温度相关的材料属性。采用完整物理模型可获得性能更优、温度鲁棒性更强的设计，且代价可控。

title: From Zero to Mega-Gauss Fields: Comprehensive Magnetophotonic Spectroscopy of Graphene Dirac Cones
summary: We investigate the infrared magneto-optical response of n-doped epitaxial graphene on 4H-SiC in ultrahigh magnetic fields up to 560~T, utilizing single-turn coil and electromagnetic flux compression techniques. The measured absorption spectra are anomalously broad, strongly deviating from conventional cyclotron resonance. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) reveals a distorted Dirac dispersion featuring a ``camel-back" structure with an energy gap of $E_g \sim 0.2$~eV. Using the band parameters extracted via a generalized bilayer graphene model, we construct a Landau level (LL) fan chart that dictates a critical level crossing between the $N=0^+$ and $N=0^-$ states near 160--200~T. At this threshold, the optical transition mechanism undergoes a dramatic shift from an electron-dominated collective mode to a cooperative electron-hole collective excitation. Furthermore, the extreme-field absorption spectra under thulium fiber laser excitation ($\hbarω_0 = 0.636$~eV)---culminating in a massive resonance near 400~T with a shoulder at 200~T---are excellently reproduced by a collective Alfvén wave model. This analysis also evidences a magnetic-field-induced enhancement of the sublattice potential asymmetry parameter (from 0.10~eV to 0.12~eV). This directly signifies that the macroscopic electron-hole band asymmetry is further amplified by the applied magnetic field. Ultimately, the field-induced energy inversion generates a strongly interacting, fully compensated electron-hole plasma. The resonant excitation of Alfvén waves in this regime demonstrates that a pristine tabletop analog to the relativistic electron-positron plasmas found in astrophysical extremes can be elegantly realized within a 2D graphene system.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了n掺杂外延石墨烯在高达560 T的超强磁场下的红外磁光响应，发现吸收谱异常宽化，偏离传统回旋共振。通过ARPES揭示\"驼峰\"结构的扭曲狄拉克色散，结合广义双层石墨烯模型构建朗道能级图，预测量子临界能级交叉发生在160-200 T。在该阈值处，光学跃迁机制从电子主导的集体模式转变为电子-空穴联合集体激发。实验谱被集体Alfvén波模型完美复现，并证明磁场增强了子格势不对称参数。最终在2D石墨烯体系中实现了类似天体物理中相对论性电子-正电子等离子体的桌面模拟。
AI.motivation: 探索石墨烯在极端磁场条件下的量子相变行为，特别是朗道能级交叉导致的电子-空穴等离子体形成，以及验证二维体系中 Alfvén波激发的可能性，从而为相对论性电子-正电子等离子体提供桌面实验平台。
AI.method: 使用单匝线圈和电磁磁通压缩技术在高达560 T的超强磁场下进行红外磁光吸收测量，结合ARPES表征电子结构，采用广义双层石墨烯模型提取能带参数，构建朗道能级图预测能级交叉，并使用集体Alfvén波模型拟合极端磁场下的吸收谱。
AI.result: 实验观测到异常宽化的吸收谱，发现N=0+和N=0-态在160-200 T发生临界能级交叉。在~400 T处观察到巨共振峰（伴有200 T的肩峰），被集体Alfvén波模型完美再现。磁场增强了子格势不对称参数从0.10 eV至0.12 eV，表明磁场进一步放大了电子-空穴带不对称性。
AI.conclusion: 强磁场诱导的能量反转产生了强相互作用的、完全补偿的电子-空穴等离子体，其Alfvén波共振激发证明2D石墨烯可以优雅地实现天体物理极端条件下的相对论性电子-正电子等离子体桌面模拟。

title: Metallic Bonding-Driven Elastic Softness and Optical Response in the Mg-Rich Laves-Phase LaMg2
summary: A systematic first-principles investigation of the structural, electronic, mechanical, and optical properties of the cubic C15 Laves-phase intermetallic compound LaMg2 is performed within density functional theory. The calculated elastic constants satisfy the mechanical stability criteria for cubic crystals, confirming the intrinsic stability of the C15 phase. LaMg2 exhibits relatively low bulk, shear, and Young's moduli, indicating enhanced compressibility and elastic softness compared with transition-metal-based Laves phases. Direction-dependent elastic analysis reveals moderate anisotropy in Young's modulus, shear modulus, and Poisson's ratio, whereas linear compressibility remains nearly isotropic, consistent with the high crystallographic symmetry. The ductile nature of LaMg2 is supported by Pugh's ratio and Poisson's ratio, suggesting resistance to brittle failure and the dominance of metallic bonding. Electronic structure calculations confirm metallic behavior with a finite density of states at the Fermi level, primarily originating from La-5d states, accompanied by delocalized charge density characteristic of metallic interactions. The optical response further reflects the metallic nature through high reflectivity, strong optical conductivity at low photon energies, and pronounced absorption in the ultraviolet region. The combination of mechanical compliance, ductility, and metallic optical response highlights LaMg2 as a promising lightweight intermetallic material for applications requiring structural stability, damage tolerance, and efficient electromagnetic shielding or reflective components.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理密度泛函理论系统研究了立方C15 Laves相金属间化合物LaMg₂的结构、电子、力学和光学性质。该材料具有机械稳定性、可压缩性、弹性柔软性、延展性和金属光学响应，是轻质且有前景的结构与电磁屏蔽材料。
AI.motivation: 探索轻质金属间化合物LaMg₂（C15 Laves相）的综合物理性质，评估其在结构稳定、损伤容限和电磁屏蔽等应用中的潜力。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论进行第一性原理计算，包括弹性常数计算（验证立方晶体的力学稳定性准则）、方向依赖的弹性分析（杨氏模量、剪切模量、泊松比、线性压缩率）、电子结构计算（态密度、电荷密度）以及光学响应计算。
AI.result: LaMg₂满足立方晶体力学稳定性准则；具有较低的体模量、剪切模量和杨氏模量，表现出增强的可压缩性和弹性柔软性；杨氏模量、剪切模量和泊松比具有中等各向异性，而线性压缩率几乎各向同性；Pugh比和泊松比表明其延展性和金属键合主导；费米能级处存在有限态密度（主要来自La-5d态），电荷密度呈离域化特征；光学响应表现为高反射率、低光子能量下的强光电导率和紫外区的显著吸收。
AI.conclusion: LaMg₂兼具力学顺应性、延展性和金属光学响应，是用于结构稳定性、损伤容限及高效电磁屏蔽或反射组件应用的有前景的轻质金属间材料。

title: Competing collinear and non-collinear spin textures imaged by spatially-resolved REXS in Eu(Al0.4Ga0.6)4
summary: Here, we use resonant elastic x-ray scattering (REXS) to investigate the inhomogeneity of the zero-field magnetic spin texture of Eu(Al$_{0.4}$Ga$_{0.6}$)$_4$. By using spatially-resolved REXS, we show that the two magnetic transitions at T$_{N1}$ = 17 K and T$_{N2}$ = 14 K originate from two nearly degenerate, yet distinct, orthogonal pairs of q-vectors. The corresponding phases are segregated spatially, such that one fraction of the sample comprises coexisting orthogonal spin-density-wave domains, while another fraction hosts coexisting orthogonal helical domains. Additionally, the helical state forms inversion domains indicating that the inversion symmetry is not broken prior the magnetic transition. Our results suggest that the magnetic state is single-q and revealed a large variation of spin textures across a 0.8 - 1 mm area of the sample surface. These results demonstrate clear differences between the locally and globally probed magnetic textures, typically assumed to be representative of the system as a whole, highlighting the importance of spatially-resolved probes for accurately describing the magnetic behavior of this class of materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用共振弹性X射线散射（REXS）研究Eu(Al₀.₄Ga₀.₆)₄中零场磁性自旋织构的不均匀性。通过空间分辨REXS，发现两个磁相变（T_N1=17K和T_N2=14K）源于两对近简并但不同的正交q矢量，对应相在空间上分离：样品一部分共存正交自旋密度波畴，另一部分共存正交螺旋畴。螺旋态还形成反演畴，表明反演对称性在磁相变前未被破坏。结果表明磁态为单q，且0.8-1mm面积内自旋织构变化很大，凸显了空间分辨探针的重要性。
AI.motivation: 传统全局探测手段（如常规X射线散射或磁化测量）假设所测磁性织构能代表整个体系，但Eu(Al,Ga)₄这类材料中可能存在空间不均匀的磁性状态。作者旨在揭示局部与全局探测的磁性织构之间的差异，强调空间分辨测量对于准确描述此类材料磁性行为的重要性。
AI.method: 采用共振弹性X射线散射（REXS）技术，并引入空间分辨模式，对Eu(Al₀.₄Ga₀.₆)₄样品表面0.8-1mm区域进行扫描，以分辨不同空间位置的磁q矢量和自旋织构类型，分析两个磁相变对应的磁序结构及其空间分布。
AI.result: 1) 两个磁相变T_N1=17K和T_N2=14K由两对近简并但不同的正交q矢量引起。2) 样品不同空间区域出现不同类型的磁序：一部分区域共存正交自旋密度波畴，另一部分共存正交螺旋畴。3) 螺旋态中存在反演畴，说明反演对称性在磁相变前未被打破。4) 磁态本质为单q，但自旋织构随空间位置变化显著。
AI.conclusion: 局部与全局测量的磁性织构存在明显差异，传统全局探测假设可能不适用于此类材料。空间分辨的REXS是准确描述Eu(Al,Ga)₄等材料复杂磁性行为的关键手段，对理解多q竞争、磁性畴结构及对称性破缺机制具有重要价值。

title: Revealing time characteristics of optical excitations in dielectric and plasmonic structures through cathodoluminescence interferometry
summary: Cathodoluminescence (CL) spectroscopy provides access to optical excitations with nanometer spatial resolution, but direct time-resolved measurements of optical resonances remain challenging. Here, we demonstrate that CL interferometry provides access to the temporal response, phase behavior, and modal spectral structure of resonant nanoscale scatterers without requiring ultrafast pump-probe schemes. We develop an analytical framework in which Fourier transformation angle- and frequency-resolved CL interferograms yields the decay time of optical resonances governed by the linear optical response. Multimode resonators exhibit characteristic temporal CL beating signatures associated with spectral mode splitting. By exploiting transition radiation emitted from a nearby metallic surface as a broadband reference, we further demonstrate phase retrieval and cross-correlation measurements between instantaneous and resonant emission processes. Experimental measurements on Au nanoparticles, broadband plasmonic emitters, Au nanostars, and Si nanospheres supporting multipolar Mie resonances confirm the theoretical predictions, and decay times in the range 1-10 fs are derived for each system. Our results establish CL interferometry as a powerful approach for accessing spectral, spatial, and phase information within a single nanoscale measurement with fs resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了阴极发光（CL）干涉测量法无需超快泵浦-探测方案，即可直接获取纳米尺度光学共振的时间响应、相位行为和模态光谱结构。通过傅里叶变换角度和频率分辨的CL干涉图，可解析光学共振的衰减时间；多模共振器表现出特征性的时间CL拍频信号。实验在Au纳米颗粒、宽带等离激元发射体、Au纳米星和支持多极米氏共振的Si纳米球上验证了理论预测，测得衰减时间为1-10 fs。
AI.motivation: CL光谱虽能提供纳米级空间分辨的光学激发信息，但直接进行光学共振的时间分辨测量一直具有挑战性，传统方法依赖超快泵浦-探测系统，实验复杂且成本高。
AI.method: 开发了一个分析框架，通过对角度和频率分辨的CL干涉图进行傅里叶变换，提取由线性光学响应决定的共振衰减时间。利用邻近金属表面发射的跃迁辐射作为宽带参考，实现相位恢复和瞬时/共振发射过程之间的互相关测量。
AI.result: 在Au纳米颗粒、宽带等离激元发射体、Au纳米星和Si纳米球上验证了理论预测，成功推导出各系统的衰减时间（1-10 fs范围）。多模共振器展示了模态光谱分裂对应的CL时间拍频特征。
AI.conclusion: CL干涉测量法被确立为一种强大的方法，可在单次纳米尺度测量中以飞秒级分辨率同时获取光谱、空间和相位信息。

title: Universal Density Control of Surface Reconstruction in Two-Dimensional Metals
summary: We identify a unified thickness criterion for surface reconstruction in ultrathin metal sheets. The critical thickness is governed by the change in surface atomic density upon reconstruction: thinning always favors structural changes that increase this density. Thus, thinning suppresses the (1x2) reconstruction of 5d noble metal (110) sheets but promotes the quasi-hexagonal reconstruction of 4d noble metal (001) sheets. Density functional calculations validate these trends and show only minor corrections from surface stress and quantum-oscillation effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了超薄金属薄片表面重构的统一厚度判据：临界厚度由重构前后表面原子密度的变化决定，减薄总是有利于增加表面原子密度的结构变化。
AI.motivation: 理解超薄金属薄片中表面重构如何受厚度影响，以及是否存在统一的物理判据来预测这种影响。
AI.method: 提出基于表面原子密度变化的统一厚度判据，并通过密度泛函理论计算验证该判据在5d贵金属(110)面(1x2)重构和4d贵金属(001)面准六方重构中的适用性，同时评估表面应力和量子振荡效应的修正。
AI.result: 密度泛函计算验证了该趋势：减薄抑制5d贵金属(110)面的(1x2)重构，但促进4d贵金属(001)面的准六方重构；表面应力和量子振荡效应仅产生次要修正。
AI.conclusion: 表面重构的厚度依赖性可统一由表面原子密度变化来解释，这一判据为超薄金属材料的结构调控提供了理论指导。

title: Sum rules and density-wave modes in spin-singlet fractional quantum Hall fluids
summary: Fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states are prototypical examples of strongly interacting topologically ordered systems. In this work, we obtain thermodynamic fits on the plane for the pair correlation function, and its Fourier transform, the static structure factor, of two-component spin-singlet Halperin and Jain FQH fluids by expanding them in the recently introduced basis of the orthogonal associated Laguerre polynomials [Fulsebakke et al., SciPost Phys. 14, 149 (2023), https://doi.org/10.21468/SciPostPhys.14.6.149 ] and ascertaining the expansion coefficients by fitting them to large-system Monte Carlo data evaluated using their trial wavefunctions. In this fitting procedure, aside from constraining the exact short-distance behavior of the wavefunction, we also derive and enforce the sum rules that the long-wavelength expansion of the static structure factor must adhere to. We show that incorporating these constraints is crucial for obtaining numerically stable and accurate values of the long-wavelength Girvin-MacDonald-Platzman (GMP)/symmetric density-wave excitation gap. We further extend this approach to spin-resolved density-correlation functions, enabling the evaluation of the gap of the antisymmetric density-wave mode for these spin-singlet FQH states. Finally, we use the density-correlators to compute variational energies of the states and construct phase diagrams for bilayer FQH systems. These could be relevant for understanding recent bilayer FQH experiments that map out the phase diagram by tuning the interlayer separation and density-imbalance/layer-polarization.

AI.tldr: 本文通过正交关联拉盖尔多项式基组对双组分自旋单态Halperin和Jain分数量子霍尔（FQH）流体的对关联函数及其傅里叶变换——静态结构因子进行热力学极限下的拟合，并利用大系统蒙特卡洛数据确定展开系数。通过约束波函数短距离行为和长波长求和规则，获得了数值稳定且精确的长波长Girvin-MacDonald-Platzman（GMP）/对称密度波激发间隙，并将方法推广到自旋分辨的密度关联函数以评估反对称密度波模式的间隙，最终计算变分能量并构建双层FQH系统的相图。
AI.motivation: FQH态是强关联拓扑有序系统的典型代表。准确计算其长波长激发间隙（如GMP间隙）对于理解其低能激发谱和相图至关重要，但现有的数值方法在长波长极限下往往面临数值不稳定和精度不足的问题。此外，理解双层FQH系统中的层间分离和密度不平衡可调的激发模式（包括反对称密度波模式）对解释近期双层FQH实验具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者采用正交关联拉盖尔多项式基组对两分量自旋单态FQH流的对关联函数和静态结构因子进行平面上的热力学展开，通过拟合大系统蒙特卡洛试态波函数数据确定展开系数。拟合过程中除约束波函数精确的短距离行为外，还推导并强制施加静态结构因子长波长展开必须满足的求和规则。该方法进一步推广至自旋分辨的密度关联函数，用于评估反对称密度波模式的间隙，并利用密度关联子计算变分能量、构建双层FQH系统的相图。
AI.result: 结果表明，在拟合过程中纳入长波长求和规则约束对于获得数值稳定且精确的GMP/对称密度波激发间隙至关重要。该方法成功扩展至自旋分辨密度关联函数，实现了自旋单态FQH态反对称密度波模式间隙的评估，并利用密度关联子计算了变分能量，构建了双层FQH系统的相图，为解读近期双层FQH实验中通过调节层间分离和密度不平衡/层极化绘制的相图提供了理论支撑。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一种系统的、数值稳定的方法来精确计算双组分自旋单态FQH流体的长波长激发间隙和变分能量，将正交拉盖尔多项式基组方法从单组分推广到双组分系统。强制施加求和规则约束是提高长波长量精度和稳定性的关键。该方法构建的相图与近期双层FQH实验测量的相图具有潜在相关性，为实验现象提供了重要的理论理解和预测工具。

title: Anisotropic magnon spin transport in CrPS$_4$
summary: Crystal anisotropy provides a powerful route for realizing direction-dependent transport in solid-state systems. While its influence on electronic transport is well established, the role of anisotropy in magnon spin transport in van der Waals magnets is largely unexplored. Here, in a nonlocal geometry, utilizing the monoclinic van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS$_4$, we observe pronounced anisotropy in both electrically and in thermally excited magnon spin transport. Electrically generated magnons exhibit a magnon spin conductivity at least 2.2 times larger and a spin diffusion length at least 2.7 times longer for transport along the crystallographic-b axis compared to the crystallographic-a axis, where $λ_m^{a} \sim$ 211 nm and $λ_m^{b} \geq$ 575 nm. In comparison, at 8T, we find the nonlocal second-harmonic resistance associated with thermally excited magnons to be $\sim$7 times larger along the crystallographic-b axis at 25K. We further show that a magnon spin diffusion length cannot be reliably extracted from the nonlocal second-harmonic resistance, owing to the extended temperature profile within CrPS$_4$. Likewise, we show that the anisotropy in the spin Seebeck coefficients cannot be reliably estimated from the thermally excited magnon spin transport alone, as it is intertwined with the anisotropic heat conductivity of CrPS$_4$. Utilizing the electrically generated magnon spin transport, we demonstrate that intrinsic crystalline anisotropy serves as an effective control parameter for tuning magnon spin transport, opening new avenues for magnonic device engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了单斜范德华反铁磁体CrPS4中晶格各向异性对磁振子自旋输运的影响，发现沿b轴方向电激发磁振子的自旋电导率至少是a轴的2.2倍，自旋扩散长度至少是a轴的2.7倍，展示了晶体各向异性可作为调控磁振子自旋输运的有效参数。
AI.motivation: 虽然晶格各向异性对电子输运的影响已被广泛研究，但其在范德华磁体中磁振子自旋输运中的作用尚未被探索。这一空白限制了磁振子器件工程的发展，因此需要系统研究各向异性对磁振子自旋输运的调控作用。
AI.method: 采用非局域测量几何结构，利用单斜范德华反铁磁体CrPS4，分别通过电激发和热激发方式产生磁振子，测量沿晶体a轴和b轴方向的磁振子自旋输运特性，包括自旋电导率、自旋扩散长度和非局域二次谐波电阻。
AI.result: 电激发磁振子沿b轴的自旋电导率至少为a轴的2.2倍，自旋扩散长度至少为2.7倍（λ_m^a约211 nm，λ_m^b≥575 nm）；在8T、25K条件下，热激发磁振子的非局域二次谐波电阻沿b轴约为a轴的7倍。同时发现从二次谐波电阻中无法可靠提取磁振子自旋扩散长度，且自旋Seebeck系数的各向异性无法仅从热激发磁振子输运中单独估计。
AI.conclusion: 晶格各向异性可作为调控磁振子自旋输运的有效控制参数，为磁振子器件的工程设计开辟了新途径。同时研究也揭示了热激发磁振子输运测量中的局限性，提示需结合电激发方法进行更可靠的定量分析。

title: Machine-learning approach for the phase stability and mechanical properties of disordered alloys at finite temperature
summary: The prediction of stable alloys forming solid-state solutions across large portions of the composition space is a serious theoretical challenge, since one has to evaluate the Gibbs free energy, including both configurational and vibrational contributions. This requires an energy theory capable of extremely high throughput. By taking the Ni-Pd system as prototype, we construct an efficient Jacobi-Legendre machine-learning potential based on density-functional-theory data, which provides accurate energies and forces across the entire composition space. Based on a cluster expansion up to three-body terms and only 873 trainable parameters, this allows us to compute the partition function by directly integrating all accessible microstates, differing for composition, atomic configuration and thermal agitation. We confirm that Ni and Pd are fully miscible, forming an $fcc$ solid-state solution. This is only metastable at room temperature, while becomes thermodynamically stable at around 600~K, with the stability achieved first at the Pd-rich end of the composition range. Interestingly, entropy and heat capacity analysis reveal a competition between the solid-state solution and two intermetallic phases with long-period L1$_0$ structure for NiPd and NiPd$_3$. All in all, our approach offers a powerful and high-throughput workflow for the study of disordered alloys, an approach that can be extended to multi-component systems such as high-entropy alloys.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Jacobi-Legendre机器学习势与团簇展开的高通量方法，以Ni-Pd合金为原型，通过直接积分所有可及微态计算配分函数，从而预测无序合金在整个成分空间中的固溶体稳定性。
AI.motivation: 预测大范围成分空间中形成固溶体的稳定合金是一个严重的理论挑战，因为需要评估包含构型和振动贡献的吉布斯自由能，这要求一种能够进行极高通量计算的能量理论。
AI.method: 以Ni-Pd体系为原型，基于密度泛函理论数据构建高效的Jacobi-Legendre机器学习势，结合最多三体项的团簇展开（仅873个可训练参数），直接积分所有可及微态（包括成分、原子构型和热振动）来计算配分函数。
AI.result: 确认Ni和Pd完全互溶形成fcc固溶体；该固溶体在室温下仅亚稳定，约600 K时变为热力学稳定，且稳定性首先在富Pd端实现；熵和热容分析揭示了固溶体与两种长周期L1₀结构金属间相（NiPd和NiPd₃）之间的竞争。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为无序合金研究提供了强大且高通量的工作流程，可推广到多组分系统如高熵合金。

title: Floquet Green's functions for lattice electrons driven by Gaussian quantum light
summary: We formulate Floquet Green's functions for noninteracting single-band lattice electrons driven by a reservoir-stabilized single-mode Gaussian quantum light source. The source is prescribed externally and is not updated by the many-electron polarization, while an active electronic probe still conditions the source evolution through the Peierls coupling. The two time arguments of a Green's function share one source history: the lesser and greater components are obtained by convolving a shared-history four-endpoint kernel with the continuous bath kernels before the final source trace, while the bath canonical anticommutation relation yields an equal-time covariance that seeds the retarded and advanced one-leg propagations. The Peierls coupling is treated nonperturbatively within the prescribed-source model, and classical Floquet theory is recovered in the appropriate limit. Numerical calculations on a minimal one-dimensional model show finite-coupling quantum-source corrections beyond a prescribed classical drive, together with spectral reconstruction and occupancy redistribution for squeezed vacuum and squeezed coherent sources. The squeezing parameter and phase provide additional control knobs, beyond classical amplitude modulation, for both sideband structure and occupied weight. This work provides a theoretical framework for quantum Floquet engineering of condensed matter with an externally prescribed quantum light source.

AI.tldr: 本文为非相互作用单带晶格电子在储层稳定单模高斯量子光源驱动下的Floquet格林函数建立了理论框架。光源是外部预设的，通过Peierls耦合与电子相互作用，但不受电子极化反馈影响。研究者通过共享历史的四端点核与连续浴核卷积得到小于/大于格林函数，并利用浴的反对易关系获得等时协方差来播种推迟和超前单腿传播。数值计算表明，在挤压真空和挤压相干光源下存在超越经典驱动的量子修正、谱重构和占据数重分布。
AI.motivation: 传统的Floquet工程通常使用经典驱动光源，但量子光（如挤压光）作为驱动源时，经典Floquet理论不再适用。本文旨在建立量子光驱动凝聚态系统的理论框架，处理光源的量子统计性质对电子系统的影响，拓展量子Floquet工程的适用范围。
AI.method: 1) 将光源建模为外部预设的单模高斯量子光，通过Peierls耦合非微扰地作用于电子；2) 构造共享单一光源历史的Floquet格林函数，将小于/大于分量通过共享历史四端点核与连续浴核卷积获得；3) 利用浴的规范反对易关系推导等时协方差，作为推迟/超前传播的初始条件；4) 在经典极限下恢复标准Floquet理论；5) 在一维最小模型上进行数值计算验证。
AI.result: 数值计算显示：1) 有限耦合下存在超越预设经典驱动的量子光源修正；2) 挤压真空和挤压相干光源下出现谱重构和占据数重分布；3) 挤压参数和相位提供了除经典幅度调制之外的额外控制手段，可调节边带结构和占据权重。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为量子Floquet工程提供了系统的理论框架，表明量子光源（特别是挤压光）可以作为凝聚态系统的新型调控工具，其量子统计性质为光诱导物态调控提供了超越经典驱动的额外自由度。

title: Strong coupling between antiferromagnetic magnons and spoof surface plasmons
summary: Hybrid magnonic system provides a versatile platform for coherent information exchange between spin excitations and other physical degrees of freedom. While strong coupling between magnons and spoof plasmons has been observed based on ferrimagnetic spheres and localized microwave resonators, it remains unexplored whether coherent magnon-plasmon coupling can be achieved in planar magnetic structures. Here we study the hybridization of antiferromagnetic (AFM) magnons and spoof surface plasmons in a planar heterostructure consisting of an AFM thin film, a dielectric spacer, and a structured metal surface. By analytically solving the coupled Maxwell and magnetization dynamics equation, we predict strong magnon-plasmon coupling in the terahertz regime, manifested by pronounced avoided crossings in the dispersion. The coupling originates from the spatial overlap between magnonic and plasmonic modes in the dielectric spacer, and can be efficiently tuned through geometric parameters of the system. The calculated cooperativity confirms that the hybrid system can operate in the strong coupling regime, enabling coherent information transfer between magnons and plasmons. Our results establish a planar platform for plasmon-magnon hybridization, which is more amenable to on-chip manipulation and integration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并理论研究了平面异质结构（反铁磁薄膜-介电间隔层-结构化金属表面）中反铁磁磁振子与人工表面等离激元之间的强耦合，通过解析求解麦克斯韦方程和磁化动力学方程，预言了太赫兹频段的强磁振子-等离激元耦合及色散中的明显避让交叉，该平台更易于片上集成。
AI.motivation: 虽然已在铁磁球和局域微波谐振器体系中观察到磁振子与人工表面等离激元的强耦合，但在平面磁性结构中实现相干磁振子-等离激元耦合仍未探索。平面平台对片上操控和集成更加友好，因此需要验证并研究平面结构中该耦合的可能性。
AI.method: 采用解析方法联合求解耦合的麦克斯韦方程组和磁化动力学方程，分析由反铁磁薄膜、介电间隔层和结构化金属表面组成的平面异质结构中磁振子与人工表面等离激元的杂化行为，并通过几何参数调控耦合强度，计算协作度以评估耦合区域。
AI.result: 预言了太赫兹频段下强磁振子-等离激元耦合的存在，色散关系中表现出显著的避让交叉。耦合源于介电间隔层中磁振子模式与等离激元模式的空间重叠，可通过系统几何参数有效调控。计算得到的协作度确认混合系统可运行于强耦合区。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了平面等离激元-磁振子杂化平台，更利于片上操控和集成，实现了磁振子与等离激元之间的相干信息传递，为平面混合磁子系统提供了新的可能性。

title: Construction of 3D-Ferroelectric Polarization Microstructure and Detection of Polarization Invariants under Induced Flexoelectric Strains
summary: Ferroelectric thin films that are heterophased and polycrystalline possess strain sensitive piezoelectric behavior. However, a direct insight into polarization orientations within a given grain and how mechanical stresses reconfigures the ferro elastically coupled polarization orientations remains ambiguous. A polarization component resolved imaging in a Piezoresponse Force Microscope (PFM) was developed in combination with correlative structure and phonon studies that provide insights into grain orientation, domains and bending stress driven phase transitions. The method correlates the polarization invariant and the respective grain orientations present underneath. The technique facilitates an experimental inverse model approach to determine crystallographic grain orientation from the ferroelectric domain. A three point bending stage introduces a flexoelectric strain in Ba0.85,Ca0.15Zr0.1Ti0.9O3_BCZT thin films and simultaneous polarization imaging. This novel technique potentially captures the formation of new polarization invariant of a monoclinic phase that appears under high pressures. The experimental findings pave way for development of inverse modelling of heterophased and polycrystalline systems.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种偏振分量分辨的压电力显微镜（PFM）成像技术，结合相关结构和声子研究，揭示了异相多晶铁电薄膜中晶粒取向、畴结构以及弯曲应力驱动的相变。通过三点弯曲装置在BCZT薄膜中引入挠曲电应变，捕捉到高压下单斜相新偏振不变量的形成。
AI.motivation: 异相多晶铁电薄膜具有应变敏感压电行为，但直接观察晶粒内偏振取向以及机械应力如何重构铁弹耦合偏振取向仍然困难，缺乏直接的实验洞察。
AI.method: 开发了偏振分量分辨的PFM成像技术，结合相关的结构（晶粒取向）和声子研究；采用实验逆模型方法从铁电畴确定晶体学晶粒取向；使用三点弯曲台在BCZT薄膜中引入挠曲电应变，同时进行偏振成像。
AI.result: 该技术能够关联偏振不变量与下方的晶粒取向，并成功捕捉到高压力下出现的单斜相新偏振不变量。
AI.conclusion: 该实验发现为异相和多晶体系的逆建模发展铺平了道路。

title: Studying electron beam coherence using plasmon interference
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures in main text, with end matter and supporting information
summary: Energetic electrons create distinct cathodoluminescence (CL) angular distributions upon interaction with dielectric and plasmonic nanostructures, providing valuable information on coherences in the excitation pathways. A counterintuitive prediction is that the CL signals arising from the excitation associated with different lateral regions of an extended electron wave are mutually incoherent and do not interfere, while the signals originating from different structures within the electromagnetic field of a narrow electron beam are mutually coherent. We present conclusive experimental evidence of these effects by examining the angular CL emission profile from defocused electron-beam excitation of a thin silicon nitride film, which is shown to follow an incoherent sum of CL excitations within the electron beam spot. In contrast, CL interferences are observed for separated plasmonic scatterers excited within the evanescent field of a single electron. Coherence may be recovered through correlations between emitted light and post-selected electron states, for which we propose a measurement geometry that erases which-path information of the electron trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验证明了电子束激发下阴极发光（CL）的相干性效应：扩展电子波不同横向区域激发的CL信号互不相干，而窄电子束的倏逝场中不同结构激发的信号则相互相干。研究通过薄氮化硅薄膜的离焦电子束激发实验证实了非相干叠加，并观察到分离等离激元散射体的CL干涉现象，同时提出了一种通过光-电子关联测量恢复相干性的几何构型。
AI.motivation: 理解高能电子与介电/等离激元纳米结构相互作用时的激发路径相干性，对于利用CL角分布提取纳米结构的光学性质至关重要，但已有理论预测中存在反直觉的相干性效应，缺乏直接的实验验证。
AI.method: 通过测量离焦电子束激发薄氮化硅薄膜的CL角发射分布，验证非相干叠加效应；通过观察分离等离激元散射体在单个电子倏逝场中的CL干涉，验证相干效应；并提出通过光-电子关联测量和末态电子态后选择来擦除路径信息以恢复相干性的测量几何方案。
AI.result: 实验证实了电子束斑内不同横向区域激发的CL信号以非相干和方式叠加；分离的等离激元结构在单个电子的倏逝场激励下产生可观察的CL干涉条纹；提出的关联测量结构可恢复电子路径的相干性。
AI.conclusion: CL角发射分布中相干性的有无取决于电子波函数的空间分布与激发几何，通过电子态后选择和光-电子关联测量可以操控和恢复相干性，这为纳米尺度的量子光学测量提供了新的自由度。

title: Enhanced Screening in Epitaxial Graphene via Nearly Free-Electron Metal Intercalation
summary: Graphene exhibits extraordinarily high carrier mobility, making it a promising platform for next-generation electronics. Scalable growth on SiC, however, suffers from limited dielectric screening at the graphene-substrate interface, degrading electronic performance. In this work, we systematically enhance dielectric screening by intercalating a bilayer of indium at the graphene-SiC interface. Using graphene's plasmaronic signature observed in angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy as a proxy for interaction strength, we quantitatively demonstrate strong dielectric screening arising from the interplay of both indium layers. Layer-resolved density functional theory shows that the first indium layer acts as a buffer that absorbs substrate interactions, enabling the second layer to form a nearly free-electron system that efficiently screens the graphene layer above. Experiments with only a single intercalated indium layer reveal reduced screening, confirming the essential role of the second layer. Our results establish 2ML indium intercalation as a powerful route for engineering dielectric environments in graphene.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在石墨烯-SiC界面试剂插入双层铟（2ML indium），系统性地增强了介电屏蔽效应。利用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）中石墨烯的plasmaronic特征作为相互作用强度的探针，结合层分辨密度泛函理论（DFT），定量证明了双层铟的协同屏蔽机制：第一层作为缓冲层吸收衬底相互作用，第二层形成近自由电子体系高效屏蔽石墨烯。单层铟对照实验证实了第二层的必要性。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯具有极高的载流子迁移率，是下一代电子器件的理想平台。然而在SiC上规模化生长的石墨烯受限于石墨烯-衬底界面的介电屏蔽不足，导致电子性能退化。亟需找到有效增强界面介电屏蔽的方法。
AI.method: 1）在石墨烯-SiC界面插入双层铟原子层；2）利用ARPES中石墨烯的plasmaronic特征作为相互作用强度的定量探针；3）结合层分辨DFT计算揭示各层铟的独立作用机制；4）通过单层铟插入对照实验验证双层结构的必要性。
AI.result: 定量证明了双层铟插入能产生强介电屏蔽效应，且这种屏蔽来自两层铟的协同作用：第一层铟作为缓冲层吸收衬底相互作用，第二层铟形成近自由电子系统有效屏蔽石墨烯。单层铟实验显示屏蔽效果减弱，证实第二层铟不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 确立了2ML铟插入是实现石墨烯介电环境工程化的有效途径，为在SiC上获得高性能石墨烯电子器件提供了可行策略。

title: Assessing fidelity-limiting factors and achieving single-qubit gate fidelity beyond 99.999% in driven silicon spin qubits
summary: In semiconductor single-spin qubits, high-fidelity quantum gates have been demonstrated; however, achieving consistent performance remains challenging due to variations in driven qubit coherence, which is less explored than free-evolution coherence such as $T_2^*$. Here, we report single-qubit gate fidelities above 99.999%, achieved by dramatically extending the driven-spin coherence time and suppressing off-resonant driving effects that are detrimental to accurate fidelity benchmarking. We demonstrate that removing proximal reservoirs significantly enhances the spin-locking coherence time ($T_{1ρ}$), a critical metric for qubits under microwave driving. Furthermore, we reveal that in typical spin qubit setups using parity readout and rectangular pulses, off-resonant excitation of neighboring qubits causes substantial benchmarking artifacts. By optimizing device conditions to mitigate microwave-induced degradation and implementing spectrally tailored pulse shaping, we achieve a $π/2$ gate fidelity of 99.99920(2)%, with remaining errors primarily limited by incoherent noise. These results showcase the mechanisms that bound fidelity benchmarking in state-of-the-art silicon spin qubits and provide practical guidelines for achieving and verifying high fidelities in these systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文报道了在半导体单自旋量子比特中实现高达99.999%的单量子比特门保真度，通过大幅延长驱动自旋相干时间（T1ρ）并抑制失谐驱动效应来实现，同时揭示了奇偶性读出和矩形脉冲导致的邻近量子比特失谐激发会引发基准测试伪影，并通过优化器件条件与频谱整形脉冲实现了99.99920(2)%的π/2门保真度。
AI.motivation: 尽管半导体单自旋量子比特已展示高保真度量子门，但实现一致性性能仍具挑战性，因为驱动量子相干性（如T1ρ）的变异性远未被充分研究，相比自由演化相干性（如T2*）更少被探索。
AI.method: 1) 移除近端库（proximal reservoirs）以显著增强自旋锁定相干时间T1ρ；2) 优化器件条件以缓解微波诱导退化；3) 采用频谱定制的脉冲整形方案来抑制邻近量子比特的失谐激发伪影。
AI.result: 实现了99.999%（99.99920(2)%）的π/2门保真度；证明去除近端库可显著增强T1ρ；揭示奇偶性读出和矩形脉冲导致基准测试伪影的机制；剩余误差主要由非相干噪声限制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作阐明了限制最先进硅自旋量子比特保真度基准测试的机制，并为这些系统实现和验证高保真度提供了实用指南。

title: Multi-scale modeling of high strain rate deformation and spall fracture in poly-crystalline metals
comment: PhD Thesis, Andhra Univ., India (Jan 2024). Shodhganga: hdl.handle.net/10603/550672. Enhanced archive ed. Core content unchanged: 37 figs, 13 tabs, 110 refs. Published parts: (i) Comput. Mater. Sci. 211 (2022) 111543; (ii) J. Dyn. Behav. Mater. 9 (2023) 24-35; (iii) Mater. Today Proc. 87 (2023) 164-169, 204-209; (iv) post-award ext.: Phys. Scr. 101 (2026) 325907. Full copyrt info on page ix
summary: This thesis utilizes a multiscale method by connecting molecular dynamics (MD) based information to hydrodynamic macroscopic calculations for investigating the shock response and spallation of metals. First, shock propagation in Cu, Al, and Ni single crystals is simulated up to $100$ GPa at strain rates $>10^6$ s$^{-1}$. Shock-Hugoniot ($U_s$-$U_p$) relations agree strongly with experiments (error $<6\%$); the Foiles EAM potential shows the least deviation for Ni. Second, a multiscale framework linking MD atomic void kinetics to hydrodynamic macro-calculations is established. Using particle swarm optimization (PSO), Nucleation and Growth (NAG) parameters are extracted for Cu, Nb, Mo, and Al, yielding free surface velocity (FSV) profiles matching experiments within $8\%$ for Al. Third, deformation across ten Al tilt (STGB) and twist (STwGB) bicrystals at rates of $10^{10}$-$10^{11}$ s$^{-1}$ proves that threshold spallation depends on boundary misorientation. Phase transitions near GBs lower spall strength at high $U_p$, whereas GB plasticity prolongs pull-back and delays spallation (e.g., $14.2^\circ$ STwGB). FSV methods are found to underestimate true peak tensile strength. Fourth, the framework is extended to polycrystals via 11 STGB and 12 STwGB configurations. Voids consistently nucleate at weakened GBs. Unique NAG parameters are fitted using PSO for all 23 bicrystals. An Average Void Growth in a Fluid Element (AVGFE) model is introduced to map these distinct boundary properties into 1D hydrodynamic codes. The combined model is validated against empirical Al flyer impacts at $518$, $1588$, and $2275$ m/s. The simulated temporal FSV curves mirror experiments, with spall strength deviations tightly bounded within $2.15\%$, $2.9\%$, and $6.0\%$, respectively, and spall thickness deviations within $2.4$-$4.0\%$.

AI.tldr: 本论文发展了一种多尺度方法，将分子动力学(MD)信息与流体动力学宏观计算相结合，系统研究金属的冲击响应和层裂(spallation)行为。研究覆盖从单晶、双晶到多晶的多个尺度：首先验证了Cu、Al、Ni单晶中冲击波传播模拟与实验的高度一致性；其次建立了连接MD原子空洞动力学与流体动力学宏观计算的框架，利用粒子群优化(PSO)提取NAG参数；再次系统研究了晶界取向差对层裂阈值的影响；最后通过AVGFE模型将23种双晶结构特性映射到一维流体动力学代码中，在Al飞片实验中验证了模型精度（层裂强度偏差<6%，层裂厚度偏差<4%）。
AI.motivation: 金属在极端冲击载荷下的动态响应和层裂行为涉及从原子尺度到宏观尺度的多尺度物理过程，单一尺度的模拟难以全面捕捉其机理。现有的分子动力学模拟受限于计算规模无法直接描述宏观行为，而纯流体动力学计算又缺乏原子层面的微结构信息（如空洞成核、晶界效应等）。因此需要建立连接原子尺度信息与宏观连续介质计算的多尺度框架，以更准确地预测和解释金属在冲击载荷下的损伤演化过程。
AI.method: 论文采用四阶段的多尺度研究策略：(1) 在单晶层面，利用分子动力学模拟Cu、Al、Ni的冲击传播，验证EAM势函数的可靠性；(2) 建立MD原子空洞动力学与流体动力学耦合的多尺度框架，使用粒子群优化(PSO)算法从MD模拟中提取空洞的成核与增长(NAG)参数；(3) 在双晶层面，系统研究倾转(STGB)和扭转(STwGB)晶界的取向差对层裂行为的影响，对比FSV方法与真实峰值拉伸强度的差异；(4) 在多晶层面，提出AVGFE（Average Void Growth in a Fluid Element）模型，将不同晶界的独特空洞行为参数映射到一维流体动力学代码中，实现对真实飞片冲击实验的预测。
AI.result: (1) 单晶Cu、Al、Ni的Hugoniot关系与实验高度吻合（误差<6%），其中Foiles EAM势对Ni的预测偏差最小；(2) 通过PSO提取的NAG参数使Al的自由表面速度(FSV)曲线与实验匹配误差<8%；(3) 双晶模拟表明层裂阈值强烈依赖晶界取向差，高位错速度(U_p)下晶界附近的相变降低层裂强度，而晶界塑性则延后并推迟层裂（如14.2°扭转晶界），且FSV方法会低估真实峰值拉伸强度；(4) 在Al飞片实验中（518、1588、2275 m/s），模拟FSV曲线与实验吻合，层裂强度偏差分别控制在2.15%、2.9%和6.0%以内，层裂厚度偏差在2.4%-4.0%之间。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功构建了一个从原子到宏观的完整多尺度模拟框架，将MD获得的晶界微观信息通过NAG参数和AVGFE模型有效传递到流体动力学计算中，实现了对金属冲击层裂行为的高精度预测。研究揭示了晶界取向差对层裂机理的重要影响，并指出FSV方法在评估峰值拉伸强度时存在局限性。该框架为理解和预测多晶金属在极端冲击载荷下的动态损伤提供了可靠的工具，具有重要的工程应用价值。

title: Inferring stealthy hyperuniform correlations from quantum transport
summary: Stealthy hyperuniform disordered systems exhibit strongly suppressed long-wavelength fluctuations, producing correlated disorder with unusual consequences for wave propagation. A central quantity characterizing these systems is the stealthiness parameter $χ$, which controls the range of excluded Fourier components in the disorder spectrum. However, in realistic settings, the microscopic disorder configuration may not be directly accessible, making it challenging to determine $χ$ from structural information alone. Here, we propose a conductance-based inverse protocol to recover stealthy hyperuniform correlations from transport data. As a proof of concept, we study spinless fermions in a one-dimensional tight-binding chain connected to clean semi-infinite leads, with on-site disorder generated by imposing a stealthy spectrum $S(k)=Θ(|k|-K)$, where $K=2πχ$. The energy-dependent transmittance is computed using a recursive Green's function method and compared with target spectra through a misfit function defined over an energy window. We show that the position of the sharp drop separating high- and low-transmittance regions is strongly controlled by $χ$, while the disorder strength $W$ mainly affects the absolute magnitude of the transmittance. As a result, the misfit function displays a clear minimum close to the target stealthy parameter. Our results demonstrate that transmittance spectra can serve as fingerprints of stealthy hyperuniform disorder, providing a practical route to infer correlated-disorder parameters from transport measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于电导（透射率）的逆协议，从传输数据中恢复隐蔽超均匀（stealthy hyperuniform）无序系统的相关性参数χ。通过在一维紧束缚链上施加隐蔽谱S(k)=Θ(|k|-K)产生无序，利用递归格林函数计算能量依赖的透射率，并通过失配函数实现对χ的重建。
AI.motivation: 隐蔽超均匀无序系统在实际中微观无序构型往往不可直接观测，导致从结构信息确定χ变得困难。因此需要一种不依赖直接结构测量的替代方案来推断相关无序参数。
AI.method: 构造一维紧束缚链（自旋less费米子）连接干净的半无限引线，施加隐蔽谱无序S(k)=Θ(|k|-K)，其中K=2πχ。利用递归格林函数方法计算能量依赖的透射率，定义能量窗口内的失配函数，将计算透射率与目标谱进行比对，通过最小化失配函数来重建χ。
AI.result: 发现透射率中高/低透射区域间急剧下降的位置主要由χ控制，而无序强度W主要影响透射率的绝对幅度。失配函数在接近目标χ处呈现清晰的最小值，表明该方法可以有效重建隐蔽参数。
AI.conclusion: 透射率谱可以作为隐蔽超均匀无序的"指纹"，为从传输测量中推断相关无序参数提供了实用途径。

title: Floquet Engineering of Topological Phases and Magneto-Optical Response in a Driven $d$-wave Altermagnet
summary: We study how Floquet driving with linearly polarized light controls the topology and magneto-optical response of a two-dimensional (2D) $d$-wave altermagnet. In the absence of linearly polarized optical field and under spin conservation, we find that the system hosts a spin-Chern (a quantum-spin-Hall analog) phase with Chern numbers of opposite sign in the two spin sectors. The irradiated optical field breaks the $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ crystalline antiunitary symmetry between the spin sectors. Symmetry breaking originates from polarization-dependent Peierls phases, which renormalize hopping anisotropically along the two axes. The resulting spin-selective gap closures produce intermediate Chern-insulating phases with $C=\pm1$. The drive amplitude $A_0$ determines the inversion thresholds, while rotating the polarization by $π/2$ swaps the spin sectors and reverses the Chern number. Using the Kubo formalism, we compute the frequency-dependent longitudinal and Hall conductivities and derive the corresponding Faraday and Kerr rotations for a free-standing conducting sheet. The longitudinal response tracks the Floquet-renormalized interband thresholds, whereas the optical Hall response, together with the sign of the magneto-optical rotations, distinguishes the two opposite Berry-curvature chiralities. Sizable Kerr angles occur only within narrow resonant windows and should be interpreted together with the reflected intensity and Kerr ellipticity. These results identify linearly polarized light as a symmetry-selective handle for spin-resolved band inversion, Chern-number switching, and contact-free optical detection in $d$-wave altermagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了线偏振光Floquet驱动对二维d波交替磁体中拓扑性质和磁光响应的调控。研究发现，在线偏振光照射下，自旋扇区间的C4zT晶体反幺正对称性被破坏，导致自旋选择性带隙闭合，产生C=±1的拓扑相变。通过Kubo公式计算了频域纵向和霍尔电导率，并推导了法拉第和克尔旋转，为d波交替磁体中自旋分辨能带反转、Chern数切换和无接触光学探测提供了一种对称性选择性的调控手段。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体（altermagnet）作为一种新兴的磁性材料类别，兼具反铁磁的净零磁化和自旋劈裂的电子能带结构，在拓扑和自旋电子学领域具有重要应用潜力。然而，如何通过光学手段选择性调控其自旋分辨的拓扑性质仍是一个未解决的问题。本文旨在探索线偏振光作为一种对称性选择性工具，能否实现对d波交替磁体拓扑相变和磁光响应的精确控制。
AI.method: 本文采用Floquet理论分析线偏振光驱动的二维d波交替磁体。首先，在无光场和自旋守恒条件下，识别系统的自旋Chern（量子自旋霍尔类似）相态。其次，通过分析光场诱导的极化依赖Peierls相位对各向异性跳跃的重整化，揭示C4zT对称性的破坏机制。利用外加光场振幅A0和偏振方向作为调控参数，研究自旋选择性带隙闭合和Chern数反转的相变过程。最后，采用Kubo formalism计算频率依赖的纵向和霍尔电导率，推导法拉第和克尔旋转，分析磁光响应与Berry曲率手性之间的关联。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 无光场时系统具有Chern数符号相反的自旋Chern相；(2) 线偏振光通过极化依赖Peierls相位破坏C4zT对称性，导致各向异性跳跃重整化；(3) 驱动振幅A0决定带隙反转阈值，偏振旋转π/2可交换自旋扇区并反转Chern数；(4) 纵向电导率反映Floquet重整化的带间阈值，而光学霍尔响应和磁光旋转符号可区分相反的Berry曲率手性；(5) 显著的Kerr角仅出现在窄共振窗口内，需结合反射强度和Kerr椭圆率共同解释。
AI.conclusion: 本文证实线偏振光可作为d波交替磁体中自旋分辨能带反转和Chern数切换的高效对称性选择性工具，并提供了通过磁光响应进行无接触光学探测的理论框架。该研究为交替磁体在拓扑光电子学和自旋电子学中的应用开辟了新途径。

title: Oscillation modes of skyrmion strings in a ferromagnetic film
summary: It is shown that a skyrmion string in a ferromagnetic film consisting of $N$ atomic layers exhibits flexural oscillations at eigenfrequencies $|ω_{m}|=(4J'S/\hbar)\sin^{2}[πm/(2N)]$, where $J'$ is the interlayer exchange coupling, $S$ is the length of the atomic spin, and $m=1,...,N-1$. This result is confirmed numerically for individual skyrmion strings in a discrete microscopic spin-lattice model of up to ten atomic layers, as well as for skyrmion-string lattices at finite temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了铁磁薄膜中N原子层的斯格明子弦具有弯曲振荡模式，其本征频率公式为|ω_m|=(4J'S/ℏ)sin²[πm/(2N)]，并通过数值模拟验证了该结果。
AI.motivation: 理解斯格明子弦在有限厚度铁磁薄膜中的动力学行为，特别是其弯曲振荡特性，这对于斯格明子器件的应用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 理论推导了N层原子层铁磁薄膜中斯格明子弦的振荡本征频率公式，并在离散微观自旋晶格模型中（最多十层）对单个斯格明子弦进行了数值模拟验证，同时也在有限温度下对斯格明子弦晶格进行了验证。
AI.result: 推导出振荡本征频率公式|ω_m|=(4J'S/ℏ)sin²[πm/(2N)]，该结果在最多十层的离散微观自旋晶格模型中得到数值确认，并在有限温度下扩展到斯格明子弦晶格也成立。
AI.conclusion: 斯格明子弦在铁磁薄膜中的弯曲振荡频率由层间交换耦合和层数决定，理论预测与数值模拟一致，表明该理论框架能准确描述斯格明子弦的动力学行为。

title: Oxygen K-edge X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy Database for NMC811 Layered Cathode Materials
summary: X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) probes the local chemical environment of the absorbing atom and is one of the most powerful characterization techniques for battery materials. Here we present a database of simulated oxygen K-edge XAS spectra for the layered cathode material LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2 (NMC811), built on the atomic structures of our recent work[1]. All spectra were obtained using the excited electron and core-hole (XCH) method with the R2SCAN meta-GGA functional, as implemented in the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP). The database covers benchmark binary oxides (TiO, Ti2O3, TiO2, Mn3O4, Mn2O3, MnO2) together with a realistic NMC811 supercell containing 60 transition metal sites at three states of charge. Because each spectrum is resolved at the level of individual oxygen sites, the database links O K-edge spectral features to specific oxygen environments defined by their local coordination and transition metal neighbors. All data are freely available and can serve as a reference for spectral fingerprinting, for direct comparison with experiments, and as training data for machine learning models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个基于NMC811层状正极材料的模拟氧K边X射线吸收光谱（XAS）数据库，该数据库使用XCH方法和R2SCAN泛函（通过VASP实现）计算，涵盖基准二元氧化物及三个荷电状态下的NMC811超胞（含60个过渡金属位点），每个光谱在单个氧位点层面解析，可服务于光谱指纹识别、实验对比和机器学习训练。
AI.motivation: XAS是电池材料表征的重要技术，但实验光谱解释往往需要高质量的模拟参考数据来关联光谱特征与局部化学环境，尤其是氧K边光谱与氧的局域配位和过渡金属邻居之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用激发电子与核孔（XCH）方法，结合R2SCAN meta-GGA泛函，在VASP中计算氧K边XAS光谱。数据库涵盖基准二元氧化物（TiO、Ti2O3、TiO2、Mn3O4、Mn2O3、MnO2）以及包含60个过渡金属位点的NMC811超胞，覆盖三个荷电状态，并在单个氧位点层面解析光谱。
AI.result: 构建了一个公开可用的氧K边XAS模拟光谱数据库，将光谱特征与具体氧环境（局部配位和过渡金属邻居）建立了对应关系，可作为光谱指纹识别、实验对比及机器学习训练的参考数据。
AI.conclusion: 该数据库为电池材料中氧K边XAS光谱的解释提供了系统性参考资源，弥补了模拟-实验对照和机器学习训练数据方面的空白，所有数据均可自由获取。

title: Accelerated Discovery of Materials with Extreme Work Functions through Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Fidelity Screening
summary: Work function plays a pivotal role in technologies ranging from energy conversion and electronics to catalysis. In this work, we integrated machine learning (ML) with multi-fidelity screening to develop a data-driven framework for accelerating the discovery of materials with extreme work functions. We augmented a previously published Random Forest (RF) model for work function to include prediction uncertainty calibration and domain of applicability assessment to enhance prediction robustness. By combining the augmented RF model with universal ML interatomic potential simulations and targeted ab initio calculations, we screened 5.5 million compounds from the GNoME and Alexandria databases. This workflow identified 209 surfaces with extreme low work functions below 2.0 eV and 227 surfaces with extreme high work functions above 6.0 eV, corresponding to 136 and 172 unique materials, respectively. The resulting candidates revealed trends consistent with established chemical principles, including the tendency of alkali- and alkaline-earth-terminated surfaces to exhibit low work functions. While it also uncovered less conventional motifs: lanthanide-rich surface terminations were strongly associated with extremely low work functions, whereas surfaces containing metalloids or phosphorus at the top layer were correlated with exceptionally high work functions. This work demonstrates a scalable strategy that leverages ML models and multi-fidelity computational efforts to accelerate the discovery of materials with extreme work functions for advanced electronic, energy-conversion, and catalytic applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究将机器学习与多保真度筛选相结合，构建了一个数据驱动框架，用于加速发现具有极端功函数的材料。通过增强随机森林模型并结合通用机器学习原子间势模拟和从头计算，从GNoME和Alexandria数据库的550万个化合物中筛选出209个低功函数表面（<2.0 eV）和227个高功函数表面（>6.0 eV），对应136和172种独特材料。
AI.motivation: 功函数在能量转换、电子学和催化等领域中起着关键作用，但发现具有极端功函数的材料极具挑战性，传统计算方法效率低下，亟需一种可扩展的策略来加速材料发现。
AI.method: 将先前发布的随机森林（RF）功函数模型进行增强，加入预测不确定性校准和适用范围评估；将该增强RF模型与通用机器学习原子间势模拟及有针对性的从头计算相结合，形成多保真度筛选工作流，对GNoME和Alexandria数据库中的550万种化合物进行筛选。
AI.result: 识别出209个极低功函数（<2.0 eV）表面和227个极高功函数（>6.0 eV）表面，对应136和172种独特材料。发现的候选材料与既定化学原理一致（碱金属和碱土金属终止面倾向低功函数），同时揭示了非常规模式：富镧系元素表面终止与极低功函数强相关，而含类金属或磷的表层与极高功函数相关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了一种可扩展的策略，利用ML模型和多保真度计算努力加速极端功函数材料的发现，为先进电子、能量转换和催化应用提供新的材料候选。

title: Competition between local magnetic disorder and altermagnetism in doped FeSb$_2$
comment: 5 pages and 5 figures (main), 8 pages and 11 figures (supplementary)
summary: Recent experimental reports suggest that the narrow-gap nonmagnetic semiconductor FeSb$_2$ can be transformed into an altermagnetic metal through Co doping (Co$_{0.15}$Fe$_{0.85}$Sb$_2$), or into a magnetically disordered or short-range-ordered state through Cr doping (Cr$_{0.15}$Fe$_{0.85}$Sb$_2$). Here we explore the energy landscape and magnetic states of these doped systems from first principles, relying on Hubbard-augmented density-functional theory (DFT+U) combined with the Romeo ground-state search algorithm. Within the established virtual-crystal approximation (VCA), we show that \texttt{Romeo} finds several non-trivial magnetic states, which inform targeted explicit simulations of doping in supercells. We rely on these findings to discuss strengths and limitations of the VCA-Romeo approach versus the explicit-doping supercell approach, and how they can be used in synergy. Overall, our simulations suggest that the ground state of the Cr-doped system is a Locally Disordered Spin-Compensated (LDSC) configuration, formally compatible with Néel's L-type fully compensated ferrimagnetism, whereas the ground state of the Co-doped system is found to be altermagnetic (AFMo). This work shows how approximate and explicit simulations of magnetic alloys can be mutually informative, and establishes a protocol for studying candidate metallic altermagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT+U结合Romeo基态搜索算法，从第一性原理研究了Co和Cr掺杂FeSb₂的磁性状态。结果表明Cr掺杂体系基态为局域无序自旋补偿（LDSC）构型，而Co掺杂体系为交变磁性（AFMo）金属，并探讨了VCA-Romeo方法与显式掺杂超胞方法的协同使用。
AI.motivation: 近期实验表明窄带隙非磁半导体FeSb₂可通过Co掺杂转变为交变磁性金属，或通过Cr掺杂转变为磁无序/短程有序态。然而这些掺杂体系的能量景观和磁性基态尚缺乏第一性原理层面的系统理解，需要建立可靠的计算方法来确定其基态磁性构型。
AI.method: 采用Hubbard修正的密度泛函理论（DFT+U）结合Romeo基态搜索算法，先在虚拟晶体近似（VCA）框架下探索磁性构型空间，再据此指导显式掺杂超胞模拟，并对两种方法进行对比与协同分析。
AI.result: VCA-Romeo找到了多个非平凡的磁性态。Cr掺杂体系的基态为LDSC构型，形式上与Néel的L型完全补偿铁磁（亚铁磁）相容；Co掺杂体系的基态为交变磁性（AFMo）。两种方法的对比揭示了各自的优势与局限。
AI.conclusion: 近似（VCA-Romeo）与显式（超胞）掺杂模拟可以相互印证、互为补充，该工作建立了研究候选金属性交变磁体的通用协议，展示了两种方法在磁性合金研究中的协同价值。

title: Stable Glasses of Organic Semiconductor Resist Crystallization
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 50 references; Supporting information with 10 figures
summary: The instability of glassy solids poses a key limitation to their use in several technological applications. Well-packed organic glasses, prepared by physical vapor deposition (PVD), have drawn attention recently because they can exhibit significantly higher thermal and chemical stability than glasses prepared from more traditional routes. We show here that PVD glasses can also show enhanced resistance to crystallization. By controlling the deposition temperature, resistance towards crystallization can be enhanced by at least a factor of ten in PVD glasses of the model organic semiconductor Alq3 (Tris(8-hydroxyquinolinato) aluminum). PVD glasses of Alq3 first transform into a supercooled liquid before crystallizing. By controlling the deposition temperature, we increase the glass to liquid transformation time thereby also increasing the overall time for crystallization. We thus demonstrate a new strategy to stabilize glasses of organic semiconductors against crystallization, which is a common failure mechanism in OLED (organic light emitting diode) devices.

AI.tldr: 本文发现通过物理气相沉积（PVD）制备的有机玻璃Alq3可以通过控制沉积温度来显著提高其抗结晶能力，结晶阻力至少提升十倍，为稳定OLED器件中的有机半导体玻璃提供了新策略。
AI.motivation: 玻璃态固体的不稳定性限制了其在多种技术应用中的使用，特别是有机半导体玻璃的结晶失效是OLED器件中的常见失效机制，需要寻找提高玻璃稳定性的方法。
AI.method: 采用物理气相沉积（PVD）方法制备有机半导体Alq3玻璃，通过控制沉积温度来调控玻璃的稳定性，并观察其玻璃到超冷液体的转变过程及随后的结晶行为。
AI.result: PVD制备的Alq3玻璃表现出显著增强的抗结晶能力，通过控制沉积温度，结晶阻力至少提高十倍；玻璃先转变为超冷液体再结晶，沉积温度降低了玻璃到液体的转变时间，从而延长了整体结晶时间。
AI.conclusion: 控制沉积温度是一种有效的新策略，可以稳定有机半导体玻璃，抵抗结晶失效，这对提升OLED器件的可靠性具有重要意义。

title: Tunable chiral anomaly in electron magnetotransport in the Weyl semimetallic Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_x$Te:Cr alloy
summary: We study magnetotransport properties of semiconductor substitutional alloy Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_x$Te, known to exhibit Sn-content dependent properties of topological crystalline insulators with a semimetallic zero-gap state at a specific band inversion point. We experimentally verify the theoretically predicted role of chemical disorder in this multivalley electron system, which leads to sequential band inversions in various valleys and places the Fermi level close to the pairs of Weyl nodes, as identified in the density functional theory calculations. Doping with mixed-valence Cr resonant impurities enables exploitation of the unique properties of dopant resonant states, which provide an effective means of tuning carrier concentration. The combination of these two effects results in the pinning of the Fermi level in the vicinity of the nodal touching points across a wide range of composition. To address the above issues, we grow Bridgman bulk crystals of Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_x$Te heavily doped with chromium and covering the full range of tin (0 $\leq x \leq$ 1), i.e. spanning both the topological crystalline insulator and trivial electronic regimes. We observe the emergence of the three dimensional (3D) Weyl semimetal phase over a range of Sn compositions, namely for $0.25 < x < 0.45$. We provide magnetotransport evidence for this and verify the relationship between the magnitude of the experimentally determined Berry curvature and the electrical properties of these materials. Quantum transport regime observed in magnetoresistance is also independently confirmed by thermal conductivity measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了半导体替位合金Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe的磁输运性质，通过掺杂混合价Cr共振杂质，实验验证了化学无序在多谷电子系统中导致各谷序贯带反转并产生Weyl节点对的理论预测，发现并在0.25<x<0.45的Sn组分范围内证实了三维Weyl半金属相的出现，并通过磁阻和热导率测量独立验证了量子输运机制。
AI.motivation: Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe具有Sn含量依赖的拓扑晶体绝缘体性质，在特定带反转点存在半金属零带隙态。理论上预测化学无序在该多谷电子系统中起关键作用，但缺乏实验验证。同时，如何利用掺杂有效调控费米能级至Weyl节点附近是待解决的关键问题。
AI.method: 生长了覆盖全Sn组分范围（0≤x≤1）的重铬掺杂Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe Bridgman块体单晶，同时涵盖拓扑晶体绝缘体和普通电子态两种区域。利用Cr混合价共振杂质的共振态特性实现载流子浓度的有效调控，使费米能级在宽组分范围内固定在节点接触点附近。通过磁输运测量探测Berry曲率大小与电学性质的关系，并用热导率测量独立验证磁阻中观察到的量子输运机制。
AI.result: 在0.25<x<0.45的Sn组分范围内观察到了三维Weyl半金属相的出现；提供了磁输运证据，验证了实验确定的Berry曲率大小与材料电学性质之间的关系；热导率测量独立确认了磁阻中观察到的量子输运机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实验验证了化学无序在多谷电子系统中导致序贯带反转的理论预测，确立了Cr掺杂结合化学无序效应可实现费米能级在Weyl节点附近的钉扎，并在特定组分范围内成功实现了三维Weyl半金属相，为拓扑材料中通过掺杂工程调控电子结构提供了新途径。

title: Structural, Optical and Magnetic Properties of Superparamagnetic Fe3O4@TiO2 and Fe3O4@SiO2@TiO2 CoreShell Nanostructures
summary: Tailoring core-shell nanostructures using iron oxide core (Fe3O4) and titanium dioxide shell (TiO2) offer a promising multifunctional platform for multimodal cancer therapies. TiO2 shell exhibits photo-responsive optical properties suitable for optical imaging and phototherapies, while Fe3O4 magnetic core enables magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and magnetic hyperthermia therapy (MHT). This present work reports synthesis and characterization from core-shell Fe3O4@TiO2 and Fe3O4@SiO2@TiO2 nanostructures. Structural and physical properties were evaluated using X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Fourier-Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR), Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), High-Resolution Scanning Electron Microscopy (HRSEM), Diffuse UV-Vis Reflectance Spectroscopy (DRS) and SQUID magnetometry. This work highlights the potential use of magnetic (core) and optically activated (shell) nanostructures for multimodal therapies assisted by magnetic hyperthermia.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了核壳结构Fe3O4@TiO2和Fe3O4@SiO2@TiO2纳米颗粒的合成与表征。Fe3O4磁性核心用于MRI和磁热疗，TiO2壳层具有光响应光学特性，适用于光学成像和光疗。通过多种表征手段（XRD、FTIR、TEM、HRSEM、DRS、SQUID磁强计）评估了其结构和物理性质，突显了磁-光多功能纳米平台在联合癌症治疗中的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 癌症多模式治疗需要多功能纳米平台，将磁性核心（Fe3O4）与光响应壳层（TiO2）结合可同时实现MRI成像、磁热疗和光疗等多重功能，以提升治疗效果并实现诊疗一体化。
AI.method: 合成核壳结构Fe3O4@TiO2和Fe3O4@SiO2@TiO2纳米颗粒（后者引入了SiO2中间层），并利用XRD、FTIR、TEM、HRSEM、DRS和SQUID磁强计等表征手段系统评估其晶体结构、化学组成、形貌、光学带隙和磁性能。
AI.result: 成功制备了两种核壳纳米结构并通过多种表征方法确认了其结构完整性。该材料系统展示了磁性核心与光学活性壳层的协同功能，具备用于磁热疗辅助多模式癌症治疗的潜力。
AI.conclusion: Fe3O4@TiO2及Fe3O4@SiO2@TiO2核壳纳米结构是一种有前景的多功能纳米平台，可整合MRI成像、磁热疗、光学成像和光疗于一体，为多模式癌症治疗提供了新的策略。
